tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shāsanapāl mahāsamayasebīkarma siddhilīlāsar nāmabihar tisma// ༄༅// bstan pa skyong ba'i dam can chen po rnams kyi phrin las dngos grub kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badzra dhā ra ya/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyi las byang dngos grub kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ khyab bdag he ru ka dpal mchog gi zhabs kyi padmor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gzod nas rab zhi 'gyur ba med gang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol pa las// snying rje'i rang gzugs mi bzad 'jigs rung sgyu ma'i rnam rol khro bo'i dbang*// dgra bgegs khrag gis kun nas rab myos drag shul gom pas sa gsum g.yo// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo de yis bdud sde'i klad pa 'gem gyur cig /de yi phrin las grub pa'i zhal gyi lung*// 'di dang gzhan du bde ba'i mchog ster ba'i// srid pa'i nyes kun 'phrog byed bdud rtsi'i skyes// skal bzang mchog 'dod rnams la bdag gis sbyin// de yang srung ma'i dbang po rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing spyi bye brag gi dam tshig la yang dag par gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi ched du lhag par mos pa brtan pa dag gis tshul 'di la nan tan du bya ste/ de'i rim pa ni/ rdzas bsham bdag bskyed mchod byin rlob// spyi gtor rnam bzhi sngon 'gro 'o// so so'i las rim gtor ma 'bul// bstod pa rjes 'brang bzlas pa bya// tshogs mchod skong bshags drag bskul dang*// stob pa rnam dgu dngos gzhi 'o// mchod bstod nongs bshags brtan bzhugs bya// gshegs gsol bsngo smon shis brjod rjes// zhes pa'i dang po sngon 'gro la bzhi'i dang po yo byad bsham pa ni/ dur khrod dam sgrub pa'i khang pa mtshan nyid tshang zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang bla re lda ldi mda' dar phye phur rgyal mtshan stag gzig gi pags pa go mtshon rgyan phreng sogs kyis 'jigs par brgyan pa'i dbus su dam can chen po rnams kyi sku rten bris 'bur sogs bzhugs su gsol/

de dag gi mdun du stegs bu sum rim la dngos sam bris pa'i g.yang gzhis bkab pa la/ dang por thod pa la sogs pa'i snod bzang por gong gnon lha'i 'das gtor dang bka' srung lcam dral gyi gtor ma bcu tshar bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib myang ba'i kha zas bzang dgu dang rin chen 'bru sman sogs kyis bskor/ dar sna tshogs pa'i gur phub kyis brgyan pa tshar du dngar ba bsham/ gnyis par skong gtor rnams dang spyi bye brag gi gter srung gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams rim par bshams pa'i g.yas su thod par myos byed bzang po bdud rtsi ril bus sbags pa'i sman phud/ g.yon du khrag sna'i dwangs ma ga pur sogs kyis bzhur ba'i rakta/ gsum par mdun bskyed kyi g.yas nas brtsam ste chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ g.yon nas brtsam ste khrag gi arghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /'dre 'jigs dang gsur chen gyi spos/ 'bru mar dang tshil zhun gyi mar me/ bdud rtsi dang mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas/ bshos bu dmar nag rnams bshams pa'i bar du thun mthar 'bul ba'i gtor ma bkod/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas dang mthun rdzas skong rdzas spyan gzigs la sogs pa bzang zhing bkod pas mdzes pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu ḍā ma ru sogs rol mo'i khyad par du ma dang*/ g.yab dar nang mchod tshogs rdzas sogs dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len bzhin tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ bka' brgyad dang phur pa la sogs pa lhag pa'i lha gang rung gi rnal 'byor so so'i gzhung bzhin byed/ bsdus par spro na/ skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ āom̐ swā bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo chen por dag pa'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa ye shes lnga'i 'od zer mchog tu 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das che mchog he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gsum pa dang*/ g.yon gsum thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dbyings phyug ma sngon mo kha ṭwāṃ dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang gis dregs pa pho mo'i gdan la gnas pa/ dur khrod rol pa'i chas can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid du rnam par dag pa'i sku can bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// de'i spyi bor āom̐ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga /hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs pa mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ āom̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa bzang po las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las kun bzang yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing*/ 1$0000250sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid du snyems pa mchog tu brtan pos/ 1$0000300rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng bai ḍūrya'i phreng ba lta bus g.yas su 'khor bar bltas la spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang sbyar te/ āom̐ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/

ma hā kro dhī shwa rī st+waṃ/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas la nyer bsdu byas te thun mtshams kyi he ru ka'i skur ldang ngo*// gsum pa mchod rdzas byin gyis rlob pa ni/ āom̐ badzra a mṛta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ āom̐ swā bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal med phun sum tshogs par a las bhañdza 'bar ba'i snod bzang zhing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i dngos po rnams 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bus nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gang bar gyur/ āom̐ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda 'i bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ bdud rtsi raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la brten pa'i a yig las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod du bcud thams cad hūm̐ āom̐ swā āṃḥhā mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lngar gyur pa/ so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang bcas pa'i 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas thams cad zhu zhing 'dres pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la āom̐ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge gsum gnas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /yi ge gsum la thim ste rim par zhu ba las dam tshig gi rdzas dang ro gcig tu gyur/ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum/ rakta raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i padma 'bar ba'i snod du ra las chags med rakta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo zhing 'khrugs pa zegs ma las 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar gyur/

āom̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum/ gtor ma raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba bldag gzhib 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes par gyur/ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ bzhi pa bla ma yi dam spyi'i gtor 'bul ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab cing dag pa'i sku /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las// ye shes sgyu mar rol cing gshegs su gsol// āom̐ e hye hi bha ga bān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ shya hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// āom̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru maṇḍa la de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ badzra pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman raka stob/ rdo rje'i thal mo kha gyen du phyes la lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing*/ gong gi sngags mthar sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛhṇantu ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshaḥ

zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bcom ldan khro bo'i rgyal po ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor los bsgyur// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba po/ khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ mthing nag mi bzad srin po'i gzugs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan rngam zhing khro// gtum chen nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rab 'jigs ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa kyi// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir// rdo rje'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo/ khro rgyal gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi dmigs khyab brdal zab gsal ba// spros pa kun bral ye shes che// smra bsam brjod med rdo rje'i thugs/ khro rgyal thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod cing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pas 'dod don gsol/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dgu yi dang po dam can so so'i las rim las/ dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i phrin las ni/

āom̐ badzra a mṛta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang/ āom̐ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i klong*/ ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i do/ rab tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i lte bar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi ro dang rta ro la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po chen po rdo rje srin po'i gzugs can sku mdog mthing nag thung zhing sbom la yan lag rags pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa'i gra nas khrag 'dzag pa/ ljags 'dril zhing drag po'i rkan sgra rdeb pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas 'thor byed kyi rlung sgra 'byin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu ldog pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra smin ma kham nag gyen du 'bar ba las skar chen gyi 'od 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug dang g.yon gdug pa can gyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ mchan g.yas su tsandan gyi beng chen gzer ba'i beng stod nas lha dmag 'bum dang*/ beng smad nas bdud dmag nyis khri chig stong 'gyed pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber brtsegs mar gsol zhing*/ gser sked nor bu'i mig tshangs can bcings pa/ thod pa skam po rigs lnga'i rtse bran can gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu dang rdo rje'i do shal 'phyang ba/ yan lag sbrul gyis dkris shing mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs sogs dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas can/ sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol nas g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'gying zhing brjid pas dgra bgegs rnams brdzis pa/ gtum zhing mi bsrun pa'i nyams can/ spyi bor bya khyung nag po 'phur zhing lding ba/

sta zur gnyis na seng ge ral pa sprug pa/ rtsib logs la 'phar dred 'khyug pa/ zhabs las stag 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yon du nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la yum kro dhī shwa rī ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ ral pa thur du gtibs pa'i gseb nas me stag 'phro ba/ zhing gi pags pas stod g.yogs shing nyi zla gza' skar dang 'ja' 'od 'khrug pa/ stag lpags dang re lde'i smad dkris can/ sbrul nag gi 'phyang 'phrul dang chu srin gyi thod pas brgyan pa/ g.yas sbrul zhags dang g.yon thod skyogs rus bcud rkang klad dang 'bru mar khrag chang gis gang ba rol zhing stob pa/ g.yas su las kyi mgon po mdog nag cing mi sdug pa'i gzugs can skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag thogs pa/ g.yon brkyang gis ro'i gdan la bka' nod pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o// de dag gi shar du hūm̐ las khro chen badzra kiṅka ra sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing khros pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor zhing dmigs pa'i mgo lus 'bral ba/ g.yon thod pa dgra bo'i snying khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi smad dkris can sbrul dang thod pas brgyan pa/ gri thogs ging chen bcu gnyis sogs las byed dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor ya las gnod sbyin zangs mdog dmar nag kha gdangs shing skan sgra rdeb pa/ sdang mig gis dgra dpung sreg cing ral pa dmar po sprin ltar gtibs pa/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri 'phyar zhing g.yon bse mdung 'dzin pa/ yum bse gdong zangs mgrin can dmar nag 'ja' tshon gyi gos can byad thag dang nad rkyal thogs pa/ bse'i gyad chen bzhi/ bse mo bzhi/

mi dmar bshan pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis sogs las byed dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub tu dza las gza' bdud chen po rā hu la sku mdog dud kha srin po'i gzugs can mgo bo dgu pa lus kun mig gis gang zhing gtum rngams 'khrugs pa'i nyams can/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba'i rtse las skyin thang gi 'khor lo bskor zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag rngub cing chu srin gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ sku smad sbrul du 'khyil zhing*/ zhing gi g.yang gzhi dang thod sbrul gyi phreng ba sogs 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan pa/ srid mo gdong mo bzhi/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs srid gsum dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du ma las 'dod khams bdag mo re ma ti nag mo skem zhing rid la gtum pa'i nyams can/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa'i bar du mi ro rangs po gsol ba/ drag po'i skan sgra rdeb cing shangs nas nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ lte ba nas nyi ma 'char zhing spyi bor zla ba tshes pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can/ snyan g.yas seng ge dang g.yon pa sbrul dang dril bus brgyan pa/ g.yas khram shing 'phyar zhing g.yon nad rkyal dgra la 'gyed pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang re lde'i smad dkris sbrul gyi ska rags can/ drel rta rkang gsum srin po'i thod pa'i sga dang sbrul gyi gong smed can la bcibs nas rakta'i rgya mtshor rol pa/ nad kyi rkyal pa tshon gyi gru gu sho rde'u dkar nag bdud kyi khram shing ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga 'chang ba nag mo 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas te rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol du sprul pa dang yang sprul pho nya las byed sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang phrin las 'dod dgur sgyur zhing sgrub pa po'i re ba skong bas nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/

gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar āom̐ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/ ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri bo/ dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin byon par

bsam la/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcings te/ āom̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa/ āom̐ bhurkur ma hā kā la sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ aṅku sha dzaḥdzaḥ zhes dang*/ hūm̐/ lang ka'i yul gyi grong brdal gyi// dbus kyi ri bo ma la ya// ko ka thang dmar rgya mtsho'i do// drag shul yod pa'i rtse mo ru// dpal chen rdo rje srin po yis// bdud kyi sde rnams btul nas kyang*// gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe// ming gis dbang bskur bran du khas blangs pa// rdo rje ro langs dur khrod tshogs kyi bdag /mgon po nag po chen po dang*// nye gnas kro dhī shwa rī ma// yab yum gnyis su med pa'i 'khor// laṅka'i bdag po la sogs dang*// slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs// 'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// pho mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// āom̐ e hye hi shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ shya ho sa ma ya st+waṃ ā karsha ya hūm̐ dzaḥ e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje brag chen gtams pa dang*// nyi zla padma rin chen khri// bam chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rab 'jigs dpa' bo 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// āom̐ bhurkur ma hā kā la rakmo kro dhī shwa rī nag mo ting laṃ sa ma ya st+waṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes bzhugs su gsol/ āom̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa/ āom̐ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/

sems can gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sdongs grogs mdzod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi 'phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dam tshig 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces dam tshig gi gnyer gtad/ lha yi sde dpon tshogs kyi bdag /legs ldan nag po mthu bo che// dur khrod bdag po sgrol ba'i ging*// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig /la du la phug la sogs yid bzhin zas// thang skyes chu skyes la sogs longs spyod rkyen// 'chi med bdud rtsi la sogs dam tshig chu// gu gul tshil chen la sogs bdug pa'i sprin// zhun chen mar me la sogs snang gsal mchog /bshos gtsang bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs pas// rim gsum mchod pas tshogs bdag mnyes gyur cig /āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai widyā/ shabda pū dza hoḥ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe pū dza hūm̐/ zhes pas spyir mchod nas khyad par gyi mchod pa/ sman phud rakta gtor ma gsum 'bul tshig cho ga rigs mthun gzhan nas blangs pa'i mthar mtshan sngags la/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman phud rakta gtor ma gsum so so'i sngags btags nas 'bul/ bye brag tu gtor ma la rakta bran nas dmigs bya dgug bstim rgyas pa'am bsdu na/ nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang*/ nang mchod bran la/ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sha khrag bdud rtsi spel/

hūm̐/ rnal 'byor kun gyi dpal mgon mchog /ma hā kā la mthu rtsal can// dka' thub nag po tshur gson cig /legs ldan nag po ma rungs pa// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa bzhes// rang gi rgyal srid la gnas te// gzhan gyi sde rnams pham mdzad pa/ khram la btab pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// rol cig dgongs shig dam tshig gtso/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab// ces pa tsam gyi mthar gtso 'khor gyi sngags kyi gsham du/ ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā tsitta khā hi/ ma hā a mṛta khā hi/ i daṃ dhū pe puṣpe gandhe nai widyā ba linta pi pa to hoḥ zhes mchod/ gnyis pa dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i phrin las ni/ āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod kyi sa gzhi 'jigs su rung ba ro gsar rnying sna tshogs gcal du bkram zhing phung por spungs pa/ khrag gis sbags pa'i ro langs rnams rgod cing gar rtse ba/ las kyi bshan pa 'bum kun tu rgyu zhing nyams pa rnams 'gugs 'ching gsod gcod kyi las byed pa/ ma rungs pa'i srog chags gdug pa can rnams ngu 'bod kyi sgra dang bcas pas sha za zhing lang long du 'phyo ba/ phyogs thams cad du me rlung dmar nag drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i dbus su bhrūm̐ las dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi sgo khang rta babs dang bcas pa/ drag po'i rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas spras pa/ nang khrag zhag gi rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dbus su 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar sna tshogs padma'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma dang dgra bgegs kyi gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po khrag 'thung nag po chen po sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag cing 'jigs su rung ba/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ thung zhing sbom la gsus khyim che ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba drag tu gtsigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu blta ba/ smin ma dang ag tshom dmar ser me lce ltar 'bar zhing 'khrug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dgra snying gis mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod khrag steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri me 'bar ba dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes shing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i cod pan dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs 'phyang ba/ dpa' zhing mi sdug pa'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ he ru ka'i cod pan can/ mkha' lding bya khyi ce spyang la sogs pa sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med du spro ba/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i pang du ma las yum tsaṇḍi ka nag mo/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag yab la stob pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng bas spras pa/ gnyis ka'ang drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du hūm̐ las las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can mthing nag gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi can bya rog la zhon pa/ lhor ru las 'bar ma nag mo rtse gsum dang thun khrag 'phen pa za 'og gi gos can bya rog la zhon pa/ nub tu tri las sha za seng gdong mthing nag mdung dang dmar gtor thogs pa dar nag po'i ber gyon nas rta nag la zhon pa/ byang du pa las gza' bdud smug nag mgo bo dgu pa chu srin gyi zhags pa dang ra'i mda' gzhu 'dzin pa sku smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/ shar lhor ra las tshangs pa dkar po dar mdung dang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor ba rta dkar la zhon pa/

lho nub tu ya las gshin rje dmar nag spu gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa ra dmar la zhon pa/ nub byang du tsa las rdo rje legs pa sngon po rdo rje dang dgra snying 'dzin pa gdong lnga la zhon pa/ byang shar du du las gnod sbyin nag po ber ka dang dgra snying khyer ba bdud rta la zhon pa'o// de thams cad kyang khro zhing gtum pa mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ thod skam lnga'i cod pan dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo'i do shal rgyu ma'i ga sha la sogs pa dur khrod kyi chas sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi phyi rol gyi shar du nag po stong*/ lhor sha za 'bum/ nub tu ma mo bye ba/ byang du gnod sbyin khri sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min rnam snang chen po'i pho brang*/ rdo rje gdan/ nā lend+ra/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs par mos la sbyar ba'i spos bsreg cing dbyangs kyi nga ro rol mo du ma'i 'gyur ba dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ yul gyi ming ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan// dur khrod ming ni rab 'jigs bsil ba'i tshal// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas// dad pa dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs ma hā kā la'i tshogs// ye shes mgon po yab yum 'khor dang bcas// las kyi mgon po 'jigs byed bya rog gdong*// ma gcig lha mo 'bar ma nag mo dang*// dpal ldan phrin las mgon po seng ge'i gdong*// sha za srin po gtum chen rā hu la// sgrol ging gshin rje btsan dang gnod sbyin tshogs// bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po brtser dgongs la// dur khrod brgyad sogs zhing khams rgya mtsho nas// ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can// ma hā kā la yab yum 'khor dang bcas// drag po'i gzhal yas dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// gnyis med brtan par bzhugs la phrin las mdzod// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya mgon po 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ āom̐ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal po/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer nas 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod cig /āom̐ badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu pañtsa a mṛto da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhā hūm̐/ zhes dam la bzhag pas ci bsgo ba'i las thams cad sgrub cing bka' nod par bsam/ phyag bya ba ni/ chos sku 'gyur med dpal ldan nag po che// phrin las lhun grub dpa' brjid phyag bzhi pa// dgra bgegs kun 'dul chos skyong yongs kyi rje// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ phyi'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ yan lag brgyad ldan yid 'ong mchod yon ldan// rab gtsang dwangs pa'i zhabs bsil rgya mtshor bskyil// sna tshogs lta sdug chu skyes lang tsho bzhad// grub dang sbyar ba'i bdug pa sprin ltar gtibs// mun snang mthar byed sgron me'i nyin mor byed// yid 'ong byug pa lha yi chu bo'i rgyun// ro bcud phun tshogs zhal zas lhun por spungs// snyan brjid rol mo sgra dbyangs dang bcas pa'i// phyi yi mchod sprin 'dod yon 'dzad med gter// 'bul gyis tshim zhing dgyes nas dngos grub stsol// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ

nas shabda 'i bar dang*/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gdug pa'i snying khrag mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil// myos byed dug khrag zhabs bsil rngam zhing brjid// dbang po sna lnga'i me tog tshar du dngar// sha chen dud pa'i sprin phung lang long g.yo// zhun chen mar me bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ khrag zhag bdud rtsi'i dri chab rlabs phreng g.yo// sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas che brjid rngam// drag po'i rol mos sa gsum 'dar zhing g.yo// dur khrod nang gi mchod sprin bsam mi khyab// 'bul gyis tshim zhing dgyes nas dngos grub stsol// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā shma shā naṃ pū dza arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ sgrib pa'i dri ma kun spangs shing*// rtog pa kun las nges grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā a nu rā gā pra tītstsha swā hā/ sman mchod ni/ hūm̐/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ stong gsum bhañdza'i snod yangs su// dam nyams bsgral pa'i māṃ sa dang*// rakta'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyil// bsad khrag rba klong 'khrug pas mchod// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhañdza ru// sha lnga bdud rtsi'i dam tshig lnga// bza' bca'i 'dod yon bsam mi khyab// rmad byung bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i// mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// dpal ldan rdo rje nag po che// lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgyes par rol la phrin las mdzod// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

gsum pa dpal mgon ma ning gi phrin las ni/ āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang chen por sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po sku mdog mthing nag gtum zhing khros pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'bar ba'i ru mtshon rnon po gnam du 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon gdug pa can gyi snying dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ sbrul nag po'i ral pa thur du 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ snying phreng dang sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber brtsegs mar gsol zhing*/ gser sked dang mi lpags rlon pa'i ska rags can/ tsan dan gyi bing chen rked la btsugs pa'i sgo gsum nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'gyed pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i cod pan lhab lhub dang 'jigs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs pa/ g.yon brkyang gis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du yum dpal 'bar ma dkar mo g.yas shel gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag gtso la stob pa ma mo'i chas can/ rol pa'i stabs kyis 'gying ba/ g.yas su las mgon srog bdud nag po gri gug dang lcags par bzung nas mda' gzhu 'geng zhing kha ṭwāṃ gru mor bkal ba/ stag ral dang gzig shubs btags nas bra nag rting dkar la 'chib pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsibs la mdun nas g.yas skor du rim pa bzhin/ sku'i mgon po stag zhon nag po g.yas tsan dan gyi beng gsor zhing g.yon bdud kyi zhags pa thogs nas dpa' gtum stag la zhon pa/ gsung gi mgon po beng dmar smug g.yas tsan dan gyi beng 'phyar zhing g.yon bdud rtsi'i lcags par 'dzin pa/ thugs kyi mgon po gri gug mthing nag g.yas gri gug mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/

yon tan gyi mgon po legs ldan nag po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa seng ge la zhon pa/ phrin las kyi mgon po trag shad mthing nag g.yas beng gsor zhing g.yon dgra snying bsnams pa bra nag rting dkar la 'chib pa/ lnga ga'ang mi bzad pa'i khro bo gtum drag 'jigs pa'i nyams can/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan te baṃ gyi khar bzhugs pa/ 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti nag mo skem zhing sgeg la gtum pa'i gzugs can g.yas khram shing 'phyar zhing g.yon bhañdza bzung ba'i mchan na nad rkyal thogs pa ma mo'i chas brgyad kyis spras te rdzu 'phrul drel rta'i steng na btsan skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang ru 'dren gyi dmag dpon sde bzhi/ bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad/ myur mgyogs kyi pho nya las byed sogs srid gsum dregs pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang khros shing 'khrugs pa'i nyams can/ mi sdug pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing 'bar ba'i me'i phreng ba drag por 'khrug pa'i dbus na gnas pa'o// thams cad kyi dpral bar āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab gling phran/ ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri bo/ u tsa la yi dur khrod chen po rnams nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ

sa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po// ma hā kā la mthu bo che// gsang ba'i khro rgyal stobs po che// ma ning nag po kun gyi rje// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang*// gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang*// dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol// legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol// tshogs bdag chen po gshegs= ma ning nag po gshegs= srog bdud nag po gshegs= mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo gshegs= mgon po sde lnga gshegs= sring gcig chen mo gshegs= mthu chen sde brgyad gshegs= bdud 'dul dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol// ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod rab 'jigs rngam pa'i gzhal yas dbus// sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng*// ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan khri la/ khro rgyal ma ning 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ āom̐ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis dam la bzhag /phyag bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ mnyam med mthu mnga' gtum chen me ltar 'bar// ma rungs 'joms mdzad bdud dpung thal bar rlog /mthar byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs can// ma hā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ mchod pa ni hūm̐/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po 'khor bcas dgongs/ khyed la dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// thod chen bhañdza rlon pa'i snod mchog tu// ba liṃ gtor ma'i mchod pa rongs se rong*// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa brengs se breng*// rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ chi li li// dza gad gser skyems btung ba me re re// māṃ sa sha chen gsur dud thu lu lu// bhañdza rus pa'i tshogs ni khra la la// bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i bye brag dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa sna tshogs kun// dpal mgon ma ning nag po 'khor bcas la// dad pa'i blo yis 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe

nas shabda 'i bar dang*/ a mṛta rakta ba liṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ bzhi pa dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i phrin las ni/ 1$0000270ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000300 bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bstan srung kun gyi snying po'i bcud: bdud dgra 'joms pa'i gnam lcags 'di: dus ngan snyigs mar sangs rgyas kyi: bstan pa srung ba'i lcags rir bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'di nyid bsgrub cing mchod pa la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: dang po dur khrod drag po'i sar: maṇḍal gzhi ma nag po'i steng: sgrub rdzas mchod sprin tshang bar bsham: gzhan yang gnas kyi khang pa de: bag dro lhun chags nyid du bya: de nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug: skyabs sems bgegs bsal bdag bskyed sogs: las gzhung bzhin du shes byas la: de nas mchod pa'i yo byad la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs sbyangs bkrus: stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed steng: a las thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: sa bon gyis mtshan steng du 'bru gsum gyi: 'phro 'dus rdzas zhu nyes skyon dri ma sbyangs: ye shes bcud drangs gnyis med bdud rtsi ches: bka' srung 'khor bcas dgyes skong nus par bsam: āom̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: zhes pas mchod pa byin brlabs te: bdag nyid rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i: mdun du srung ma gsal ba ni: āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na dharma dhā tu dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: snang grags 'khor 'das chos kun stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las mdun du rab 'jigs kyi: dur khrod chen po 'jigs shing skyi g.ya'i dbus: bhrūm̐ las mthing nag gru gsum gzhal yas khang: rgya khyon chos dbyings dang mnyam lte ba ru: padma nyi zla dregs pa bsnol ba'i steng: mthing nag hūm̐ las skyes pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: ma hā kā la dregs pa kun 'dul ni:

zhal bzhi phyag bzhi mi bzad rngam pa'i gzugs: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing steng zhal ljang: g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis gri gug ral gri gdengs: g.yon gnyis thod khrag rdo rje'i dbyug pa bsnams: dmar ser ral pa gyen brdzes khro chung spro: g.yas g.yon rdo rje'i gshog pa rnam par gdengs: dur khrod chas dang dpal gyi chas bcus spras: zhabs gnyis dor stabs dregs pa'i snying gar brdzis: gsang ba'i yum mchog re ti sngo skya'i mdog: kha ṭwāṃ nad rkyal 'dzin cing yab dang 'khril: rab 'jigs me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: shar du na las klu bdud rngam pa'i gzugs: mthing nag sbrul zhags gri gug phyag na bsnams: ral pa gyen brdzes sku smad sbrul du 'khyil: dur khrod chas gsol dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: lho ru ya ma rā dza gshin rje'i gtso: dmar nag rdo rje'i thod dbyug dung khrag 'thung: dur khrod chas ldan ma he ser nag zhon: rab 'jigs dregs pa mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor: nub tu rā hu la nyid dmar nag mdog: chu srin zhags pa thod khrag phyag na bsnams: mig stong dang ldan chu srin dmar skya zhon: dur khrod chas gsol dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: byang du kṣa las srin po smug nag ni: g.yas g.yon ral gri dung khrag zhal du rngub: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad: las byed dregs pa mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor: gzhan yang bka' sdod dregs pa las byed dang: sha za bshan pa sprul dang yang sprul bcas: gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis rang 'dra ba'i: ye shes sems dpa' 'khor bcas spyan drangs bsam: sbyar spos bsreg cing rol mo sgrog: nga ro'i dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa: srin po'i gzugs can dregs pa spyan 'dren na: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: las byed dregs pa klu bdud gshin rje'i rgyal:

drang srong chen po sha za srin po sogs: rang rang sprul dang yang sprul bka' nyan bcas: dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bzhad pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong ldir zhing: rngam pa'i stangs stabs srid pa gsum g.yo ba: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das 'khor gyi tshogs: phyogs bcu'i zhing nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la dzñā na nā tha re ma ti sa ma ya dzaḥnā ga raksha ya ma rā dza rā hu la raksha sa badzra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod bskal me 'khrug pa'i dbus: log 'dren dregs pa padma nyi zla'i steng: dregs pa kun 'dul lha mchog 'khor dang bcas: phrin las bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol: padma tsand+ra sūrya ti ra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: zhes pas bzhugs gsol dam la bzhag: de nas mchod pa'i las rim ni: hūm̐: dpal chen mthu stobs dbang phyug 'khor bcas la: ma rungs log 'dren dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi: dbang po lnga dang tshil chen don snying lnga: sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang: dmar chen rakta pañtsa a mṛ ta: mthun rdzas 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab: ma lus dngos bshams yid sprul dam pa 'di: bstan srung rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis bzhes nas kyang: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung du gsol: sarba pū dza i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes mchod: lnga pa sngags srung ma'i phrin las ni/ āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po'i dbus su yaṃ las bskal pa'i me rlung dmar nag 'bar zhing 'tshub pa'i klong du ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa/ keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab 'dzings stabs su brtsigs pa'i steng du bhrūm̐ las bhañdza 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang rgya khyon tshad med pa 'jigs shing rngam pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/

padma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi gdan la trag yig smug nag yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi ma mo sngags kyi srung ma sku mdog smug nag dud sprin 'khrigs pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro gtum mi bzad pa'i gzugs can/ dpral ba'i dbyings na ye shes kyi spyan gcig dmar zlum gzir zhing blta ba/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing zla tshes lta bu'i mche ba gcig thur du gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing hūm̐ dang bhyo'i nga ro drag po sgrog pa/ ral pa kham nag thur du grol ba'i dbus na lcags kyi ral pa nyag gcig gyen du gzengs pa/ thugs ka na bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa'i nu ma gcig 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas zhing gi dbyug pa klad la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dgra snying dang lcags spyang khra thabs su 'gyed pa/ thod pa skam po'i cod pan dang do shal can/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang 'ja' sprin gyis stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan te g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la rol ba/ 'khor sprul pa'i ma mo rnam gsum/ sbyor sgrol srog gcod kyi ging gsum/ ye shes kyi ma mo lnga/ rje mo bcu bzhi/ sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sogs snang srid ma mo'i 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ ma mo'i mdun du bhyo las bshan pa srog sgrub nag mo rngam zhing khros pa/ g.yas chu gri rnon po 'phyar zhing g.yon dgra bo'i glo snying za ba/ mi lpags kyi gos dang thod rus sbrul gyis brgyan cing srid pa'i rlung nag zhon pa/ g.yas na ce spyang gdong ma/ g.yon na wa gdong ma/ mdun na 'ug gdong ma sogs sha za dang ma mo 'bum sdes bskor ba/ ma mo'i g.yas su tri las gza' bdud rā hu la smug nag mgo bo dgu pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang sbrul zhags/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhus dgra snying gzir ba/ lus kun mig gis gang zhing ro smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/

dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas can/ gza' dang gdong mo rgyu skar sogs 'jigs byed dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ma mo'i rgyab tu kṣa las gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis thod pa dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ dar dmar gyi ber dang dur khrod kyi chas can/ mkha' lding la zhon pa/ las byed pho nya sde brgyad sogs sha za bshan pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ma mo'i g.yon du tri las skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa dmar po/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes dgra mgo gzir zhing*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi ber dang brjid pa'i chas can/ ra skyes kham pa la zhon pa/ 'khor ging chen sde bzhi lha btsan bdud kyi dge bsnyen sum brgya drug cu dgyes sde mo bcu gnyis za byed mche ba can sogs dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang phyi'i khor yug la ye shes dang las las grub pa'i dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud pho nya las byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang 'jigs shing rngam pa'i gzugs 'chang zhing phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur bas sgrub pa po'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o// thams cad kyi dpral bar āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas chos dbyings yum gyi mkha'/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling*/ ri rab kyi rtse/ dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs grub pa'i gnas yul dgyes par spyod pa'i zhing khams thams cad nas ye shes kyi ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ bhyoḥ bde chen kun bzang yum gyi mkha'// rang byung ye shes spros bral dbyings// dmigs med chos sku'i dkyil 'khor nas// thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bzhengs ma// mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo che// srid gsum dbang bsgyur ral gcig ma// gsang sngags bka' srung sgrol ba'i yum// smug nag khros ma gshegs su gsol// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs ma gcig kye// ming po rdo rjes deng 'bod kyis// sring mo dam can da tshur byon// bhyoḥ

dur khrod gnas nas mkha' 'gro ma// mi bsrun bshan pa gshegs su gsol// bar snang khams nas 'jigs byed gtso/ khyab 'jug chen po gshegs su gsol// he chen brdal nas sgrol ba'i ging*// gnod sbyin chen po gshegs su gsol// dam tshig gnas nas thig le rtsal// rdo rje legs pa gshegs su gsol// bstan pa skyong ba'i dam can rnams// so so'i mngag gzhug pho nyar bcas// dam tshig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyis// phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// āom̐ ro ru e ka tsā ti snying kha ragmo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ trag raksha sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs pa ni// smug nag khros ma rag gdong ma// sngags kyi srung ma 'khor dang bcas// 'dir bshams 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs// trag raksha sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ phyag bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso// sngags srung ma mo ral gcig ma// mthu chen dregs pa chen po bzhi// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams zhing kun gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin// me tog phreng mdzes bdug spos sprin phung g.yo// 'od 'bar snang gsal dri chab lbu phreng bzhad// ro brgya'i zhal zas snyan brjid rol mo 'khrol// sha rus don snying nang rol sna tshogs dang*// rmad byung bdud rtsi rakta btung ba'i mtsho// 'dod yon bza' bca'i gtor ma bsam mi khyab// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro bda' dang*// reg 'jam lha mi'i mchod sprin ji snyed kyis// mchod do dgyes par rol la phrin las mdzod// āom̐ trag raksha sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe nas shabda 'i bar dang*/ a mṛta rakta ba liṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ drug pa lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i phrin las ni/ āom̐ swā bhā wa

sogs kyis stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du padma rā ga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zla gam sgo gcig pa 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus su/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du aṃ yig dmar po 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas aṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po sku mdog padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams can/ cung zad khro la 'dzum pa/ g.yas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rlung gi zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can zur phud la zla ba tshes pas brgyan pa/ gcer bu liṅga sgreng zhing bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams gsal ba/ dar sna tshogs pa'i stod g.yogs dang cod pan 'chang zhing*/ utpal dmar po'i do shal dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yon du yum u ma de bī dmar gsal mdzes 'dzum lang tsho rgyas shing lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang me tog dmar po'i rgyan can skra grol ba/ lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pas yab la brten te bzhengs stabs su gnas pa/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la gsang ba'i ḍā ki 'gugs byed ma/ 'ching byed ma/ rmongs byed ma/ myos byed ma bzhi ste/ thams cad kyang bindu ka'i mdog can lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa 'dzum zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ 'greng stabs su 'khod pa/ gzhan yang khams gsum gyi dregs pa can thams cad kyis bskor zhing 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de rnams kyi spyi bor āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ dang so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis tshangs pa'i gnas dang*/
