bsam mo// spyan 'dren pa ni/ lag gnyis lcags kyu'i rgya bcings te/ āom̐ ma hā de wa ā karṣa ya dzaḥdza: zhes bzla zhing dar gyi g.yab mo sbyar spos kyi bdug pa rol mo'i 'gyur ba snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ dza: tshur byon tshur byon lha chen po: 'jig rten skyong ba dbang phyug che: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs la mkhas: chags pa'i zhal la sgeg pa'i sku: gu lang chen po lha yi lha: u ma yum dang gnyis su med: khyod ni dbang phyug chen po ste: khams gsum ma lus dbang du byed: khyod ni 'jigs byed chen po ste: srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon: dregs pa'i lha chen thams cad kyang: khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags kyi: las la ma g.yel da tshur byon: dus la bab bo gshegs su gsol: zhes dang*/ sngar bzhin 'bod sngags rol mo'i sgra yun ring du sbyar bas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: zhes brjod pas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bzhugs par bsam la/ āom̐ badzra sa ma ya rakṣa hūm̐: zhes tri shu la'i rgya bstan te/ lha chen lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ gar dbang thugs rje chen po/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ lo chen bai ro tsa na/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje la sogs te rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sogs nas/ phrin las mdzod cig / ces pa'i bar dam bsgrags pas ci bsgo ba'i bka' nod par bsam mo// thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang dang ldan: lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams: dngos su bshams dang yid sprul gyi: mchod pa bzang po 'di bzhes la: me tog phreng sogs rin chen dbyig: la du myos byed yid bzhin zas: spos dang sman sbyar til mar sgron: bshos gtsang yon chab sna tshogs dang: 'bras chang rgun chang btung ba'i mchog:

sbrang rtsi bu ram mngar ba'i ro: rakta bcud chen gi'u waṃ dang: btsos dang rjen sha khu ba rkang: bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i mchog: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs: sna tshogs mchod pa 'di dag kun: bzhes shing mnyes par mdzad du gsol: āom̐ ma hā de wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widyā shabda pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ snang ba yab la stong pa yum: gnyis med sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: bde chen dga' bzhi'i rol par spel: dgyes pa chen por bzhes su gsol: āom̐ ma hā de wa sa pa ri wā ra bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha pū dza ho: zhes gsang mchod dang*/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: ye shes sgrub rdzas chen po 'di: dngos grub kun gyi dbyig tu 'bul: āom̐ ma hā de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes sman mchod dang*/ nyon mongs chags pa 'khor ba'i khrag: chags med bde chen rgya mtshor bskyil: gsang ba'i sgrub rdzas chen po 'di: mnyam nyid dbyings su bzhes su gsol: āom̐ ma hā de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rakta pū dza khā hi: zhes rakta dang*/ chos dbyings rnam dag gtor gzhong du: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: zag med bde chen mchod pa'i mchog: dam tshig bdud rtsir bzhes su gsol: āom̐ ma hā de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza khā hi: bdun pa gza' bdud kyi phrin las ni/ āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su/ e las gru gsum mthing nag mkha' dang mnyam pa'i lte bar pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan la tri du ba'i mdog can yongs su gyur pa las/

gza' bdud chen po rā hu la sku mdog dud ka mgo dgu bya rog gi zhal dang bcu/ rtsa zhal gshin rje khros pa'i zhal gsum ljang nag dud kha/ bar zhal bdud kyi zhal gsum mthing dmar ljang ba/ steng zhal lha'i zhal gsum ljang dmar dkar ba/ zhal re re la dmar zlum sdang mig gzir ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ shin tu rngams pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug cing 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog pas dgra bgegs chem chem gsol ba/ smin ma ag tshom dang ba spu'i rtse nas me stag 'phro ba/ srid gsum mtha' dag gzigs pa'i mig gis lus kun gang zhing khong nas 'khrugs pa'i nyams can/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang sbrul zhags/ 'og ma gnyis rwa'i mda' gzhu 'geng zhing sku smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ zhing chen gyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dkris pa/ thod pa skam po'i cod pan dang khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ klu rigs lnga'i sbrul gyi chun po sogs 'bar ba'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams can/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid 'bar ba/ g.yas su dza las yab rdo rje srin po mthing nag mgo bo dgu pa dbyug to dang khrag mtsho bsnams pa zhe sdang rus pa'i khri la bzhugs pa/ g.yon du phu las yum rdo rje glog 'gyu dmar nag mgo bo dgu pa sbrul zhags dang khrag mtsho bsnams pa 'dod chags khrag mtsho'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgra bgegs kyi gdan la/ nub tu ya las ljang sngon chen po ljang nag zhags pa dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa ma mo'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar lhor tsa las drang srong dkar ser sbrul zhags dang tri shu la 'dzin pa dgra bla'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du du las bdud po rog ti mthing nag sbrul dang bdud zhags 'dzin pa bdud kyi dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/

lho nub tu tsa las biṣṭi pa tra dmar po sbrul dang spu gri 'dzin pa srin po'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar du a las byi nu rā dza dud ka chu srin dang stag mgo 'dzin pa dmu bdud kyi dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub byang du du las du ba mjug ring mthing nag spu gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa gshin rje'idamag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor ya las khyab mjug chen po ser nag sbrul zhags dang chu srin 'dzin pa klu bdud kyi dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang shar du sha las sgra gcan 'dzin dud kha chu srin dang khram shing 'dzin pa sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang gtum zhing rngam pa srin po'i gzugs can mgo bo dgu pa/ lus kun mig gis gang zhing 'jigs pa'i cha byad rdzogs pa gtso bo lta bu'o// de'i phyi rol gyi shar du ma las stag srin zor ba'i gdong can dkar ser lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lhor ra las bam srin dred kyi gdong can ser nag thod dbyug dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub tu tsa las kong srin ba glang gi gdong can dmar nag dgra st+wa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du sha las 'brog srin chu srin gyi gdong can ljang nag ri rab klad la bskor ba/ bzhi ka'ang srin mo khros pa'i cha lugs can zhing gi gdan la rol pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi phyi rol du gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs te srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang khro zhing gtum pa za za rngams rngams 'phyong zhing rgyug pa'i tshul can myur mgyogs kyi rdzu 'phrul chen po'i rtsal gyis dus mtha'i me rlung 'khrug pa'i klong na gnas pa'o// de rnams kyi dpral bar āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub laṅka pu ri srin po'i grong khyer/ dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang la sogs pa rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas gza' bdud chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par

bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi sprul pa las// yang sprul mi bzad 'bar ba'i skur ston pa// gza' mchog chen po 'jigs byed rā hu la// ngang nyid chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig /snyigs dus mi bzad lnga brgya'i tha ma 'dir// sna tshogs thabs kyis gdug pa 'dul don du// thugs nyid zhi ba chos dbyings rnam dag kyang*// drag gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs shig /zhe sdang 'dod chags 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// mthu chen klu srin yab yum gshegs su gsol// srid pa gsum sogs zhing khams rgya mtsho nas// sprul pa'i gza' chen sde brgyad gshegs su gsol// phyogs bzhi nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// sring mo gdong mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol// gzhan yang bka' sdod sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs// rang rang zhing nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// hūm̐/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi pho brang nas// gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// sku mdog dud ka tse re re// dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs ya la la// dar nag ru mtshon phya ra ra// mi rkang gling bu di ri ri// spyan stong me dpung 'u ru ru// bshug pa'i glu len kyu ru ru// rngam pa'i nga ro di ri ri// dpal gyi bro chen chems se chem// 'jigs pa'i glu len tse re re// glog dmar zhags pa 'khyugs se 'khyug /tshur spyon tshur spyon gnas 'dir byon// pho brang rab mdzes gzhal yas 'dir// gza' bdud 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// hri shag ru rag raṃ nā ge tsitta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha ha ga sha la dzaḥdzaḥbadzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ 'jigs byed chen po gza' mchog rā hu la// sring bzhi sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// nyi zla padma zhing chen gdan steng du// dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol// āom̐ ke ta ke ta rā hu la sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/ phyag bya ba ni/

hūm̐/ che ba'i che mchog 'jigs byed rā hu la// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor bcas la// bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// āom̐ ke ta ke ta rā hu la pra tītstsha hoḥ mchod pa ni/ spos dang me tog snang gsal la sogs dang*// dza gad phud dang pañtsa a mṛ ta// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dgongs klong dag pas mchod// āom̐ rā hu la sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ puṣpe nas shabda 'i bar dang*/ a mṛta rakta ba liṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ brgyad pa rnam sras kyi phrin las ni/ āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ gis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar lcang lo can gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen po'i dbus su bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhir ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas bteg pa'i khor yug gis bskor ba'i shar shel/ lho bai ḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga /byang 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser las grub pa/ dbyibs legs shing lta na sdug pa rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa'i dbus su rin po che sna bdun gyi khang bzang sum brtsegs su yod pa/ sa 'og tu gter gyi khang pa bco lnga dang bcas shing*/ khor sa rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba'i dang po'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du khang bzang brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ de dag gi phyi rol du rin po che'i phung po/ dpag bsam gyi ljon shing*/ ma rmos pa'i lo thog /gter gyi bum bzang*/ khrus rdzing me tog dang ldan pa rnams spel mar gnas pa'i phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ pho brang dbus ma'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma seng ge la gnas pa'i bai yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/

khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang mdung dmar sgreng ba/ g.yon nor bu skyug pa'i gter gyi ne'u le dang dbang sdud kyi lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dbu la bse'i rmog zhu rin po che'i phra tshoms can bcings pa/ brjid bag dang bcas pa'i sku la dar dmar po'i 'jol ber dang bse'i go khrab gsol ba/ lha'i dar sna tshogs pa'i cod pan lhab lhub dang rin po che'i rgyan phreng 'od 'bar ba du mas spras pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis ri dwags kyi rgyal po'i gdan la gnas pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing skye rgu rnams phongs pa las sgrol ba/ phrag gong nyi zlas brgyan pa btsun mo sras dang pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs brgyad kyi shar nas rim pa bzhin dzam bha la ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ yang dag shes ser po gser gyi gri ring 'dzin pa/ gang ba bzang po ser po bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung 'dzin pa/ nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu 'dzin pa/ lngas rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs 'dzin pa/ ku be ra nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'jam po 'khyil ba dkar po gri phub 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang g.yon gter gyi ne'u le bsnams shing rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la 'chib pa/ brjid cing dpa' ba lha'i go khrab dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ khor sa bar ma na klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa/ khor sa tha ma na lha srin sde brgyad sogs ci bgyi'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa'i gzugs dang cha lugs can/ phrin las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor pas 'dod pa'i dngos grub char bzhin du 'beb pa nam mkha' la sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin 'khod par gyur/ de rnams kyi dpral bar āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par

bsam zhing*/ bai/ ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs kyi// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// bdag gis gdung pas spyan 'dren na// thabs dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// btsun mo blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung slad du// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// āom̐ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol ni/ pho brang gzhal yas chen po'i dbus// rin chen khri rkang brtsegs pa'i steng*// nor bdag chen po rnam thos sras// 'khor bcas dgyes par bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpadma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ phyag bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las bdag /'gro ba'i re skong sprul pa'i sku /sa brgyad sems dpa' rnam thos sras/ khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// āom̐ na mo na ma mi/ mchod pa ni/ 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol rgyal chen 'khor bcas la// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo mchog gi dam tshig rdzas// lha mi'i longs spyod 'dzad med 'dod dgu'i sprin// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs gang ba// 'bul lo 'dod pa'i las 'bras mchis par mdzod// āom̐ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ puṣpe nas shabda

'i bar dang*/ a mṛta rakta ba liṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ dgu pa zhing skyong dur khrod ma mo'i phrin las ni/ āom̐ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bhyo yongs su gyur pa las ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo sku mdog smug nag rngams shing khros pa'i nyams can hūm̐ dang bhyo'i nga ro drag por rgod pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas khrag 'dzag pa'i dgra snying dron mo za zhing g.yon srid gsum gsal ba'i me long 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa lding stabs su gyon pa/ ral pa kham nag thur du 'phyang zhing rna ba la dung long khrol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang mgo bo rlon pa'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phreng ba dang se ral kha 'phyang zhing g.yon brkyang gis ro'i gdan la 'gying ba/ 'khor gyi ma mo dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi snying dang me long 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan te gar mdzad pa/ gzhan yang gnas gsum gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dur khrod kyi zhing skyong pho mo/ las byed sha za 'bum sde/ sprul pa'i shwa na wa spyang dred sogs ma rungs pa'i 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor āom̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de wī ko ṭa la sogs pa nye ba'i zhing thams cad nas bstan srung ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ bhyoḥ dur khrod lha mo chen mo khyod// dur khrod gnas nas sku bzhengs shig /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir byon// rnal 'byor gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// brjod bral 'gyur med klong yangs nas// ye shes rang snang rol pa'i yum// dur khrod lha mo sku bzhengs shig /dus la bab kyis da tshur byon//

zhes dang gzhan yang*/ bhyoḥ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu mo che// mi bsrun srin mo'i gzugs 'chang dam tshig can// ma gcig lha mo 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i pho nya zhing bcu'i gshed// dpal 'bar mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ngan ne ma// dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i yul rnams nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir da tshur byon// bhyoḥ chos dbyings ngang las snying rjes khros pa'i yum// zhing skyong ma mo dur khrod gnas nyul ma// dam tshig gnas 'dir rnam bkra'i spyan gzigs dang*// lhab lhub dar gyi g.yab mos 'bod kyis gshegs// tshil chen gsur dud dri zhim dud pa'i sprin// 'dod dgu'i char 'beb ro brgya'i bza' btung gi /mgron du dad pa'i gdungs dbyangs snyan 'jebs sgra// rkang gling rol mos mtshon par 'bod kyis gshegs// sngon tshe nyid kyis dam bcas ji bzhin du// rgyal ba'i bstan dang rig 'dzin bdag cag gi /'dod pa'i dngos grub re ba bzhin stsol ba'i// phrin las ma g.yel las la rings par spyon// āom̐ shma shā naṃ pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol ni/ rab 'jigs dus mtha'i me rlung 'khrug pa'i klong*// 'bar ba'i dur khrod gzhal yas chen po'i dbus// padma nyi zla dbugs bral brtsegs pa'i khrir// ma gcig lha mo 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpadma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ phyag bya ba ni/ dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro dur khrod ma mo'i gtso// gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma mthu mo che// srid gsum dbang bsgyur ma rungs dgra sde'i gshed// zhing skyong ma mo 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal// āom̐ na mo na mā mi/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dmar chen mchod yon dbang po'i me tog bzhad// sna tshogs gsur dud zhun chen sbar ba'i me// mkhris chen byug pa sha rus bza' ba'i tshogs// mi bzad sgra dbyangs myos byed dpa' bo'i bcud// lbu phreng do shal g.yo ba'i rakta'i skyems// 'dod yon tshogs dang gtor ma'i longs spyod sogs// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin// dur khrod ma mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// āom̐ shma shā naṃ pa ti sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ

arghaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda a mṛta rakta ba liṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha swā hā/ gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du tshim par bsam zhing rdo rje'i thal mo gyen du phye ba bstan la/ āom̐ bhu ru ku ru i tsi ki byi u tsuṣma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥs pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ āom̐ ma hā kā la e ka dzā ṭi gu ṇa hri da hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu hya raṃ siddhi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āom̐ ma hā kā la bi kā la tri yaṃ dza: āom̐ ro ru e ka dzā ṭi snying kha rakmo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ dzaḥdza: āom̐ ma hā de wa dzaḥ.u ma de wī hrīṃ ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ ku ru ho: hri shag ru rag raṃ nā ge tsitta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha ha ga sha la dzaḥdzaḥ āom̐ ma hā rā dza sa ma ya bai shra ma ṇa ye sarba tsitta ratna hrīṃ dzaḥ āom̐ ma ma ra li pra ma ya kā li ye dzaḥdzaḥ zhes lha thams cad kyi snying po'i mthar sa pa ri wā ra sogs btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra bla/ bdud dpung sgrol ba'i dpa' bo/ bstan pa'i bka' srung chen po/ legs ldan rdo rje srin po tshogs kyi bdag po/ nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po/ mthu chen drag po zhal bzhi pa/ ma mo sngags kyi srung ma/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po/ khyab 'jug dug gi spu gri/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras/ zhing skyong dur khrod kyi ma mo la sogs te dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs

zhes pa nas/ phrin las mdzod cig / ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod pa'i phrin las gsol/ gsum pa bstod pa la dgu las dang po ni/ hūm̐/ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*// lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa'i// legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bsod nams gzi brjid 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// spyod pa rlabs chen 'phags la phyag 'tshal lo// drag shul mthu chen ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// pha rol phyin bcu mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib pa rnam gnyis dag la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med gnyis rtogs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams dang dgongs pa gcig /rig 'dzin grub thob rnams dang byin rlabs gcig /ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dang dam tshig gcig /lha srin sde brgyad rnams dang mthu rtsal gcig /sngon gyi drang srong rnams dang smon lam gcig /tshogs bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa tsam gyis bstod de zor yang ba'i dbang du byas la/ shes na bstod pa rgyas pa gzhan du 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i bstod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐/ mi 'gyur rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las// ye shes chen po'i thugs rjes skur sprul pa// ma rungs 'dul mdzad ma hā kā la'i gtso// drag po stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhir ldan/ khro gnyer gsus 'phyang mche ba rnam par gtsigs// smin ma ag tshom ser zhing dmar ba'i mdangs// gzi brjid rab 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khros pa'i cha byad spyan gsum bgrad pa yis// 'jig rten lha chen ma lus zil gyis gnon// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril bgegs tshogs sreg mdzad pa'i// nga ro 'jigs pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// rtog med rnam grol mnyam par thugs gnas kyang*// chags med snying rjes 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul// byams pa chen pos sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong*// mi gnas bde chen thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// skyon las yongs grol yon tan mthar phyin rtags// thod pa skam rlon rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// nyon mongs klu dang log lta 'joms mdzad tshul// sbrul gyis rnam brgyan stag lpags sham thabs gsol// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs byin rlabs shugs dang ldan// yon tan mchog ster khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rtog pa rab gcod nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i// gri gug ral gri g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams// chos rnams bde bar rtogs pa'i thod khrag dang*/

kha ṭwāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab g.yon// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin sku gsum dngos grub ster// phrin las thogs med ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khros pa'i nyams dang sgra skad drag po yis// bka' nyan las byed ma mo ḍā ki dang*// ging dang gshin rje sha za ma lus tshogs// rang dbang med par dbang sdud pho nyar 'gyed// 'gal byed tshogs rnams myur du brlag mdzad pa'i// drag po sgrol byed gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// drag po 'jigs byed chen po'i skur ston pa// rdo rje nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsang ba'i dgyes spyod ma gcig tsaṇḍi ka /gcer bu skra grol stong gsum gar bsgyur ma// gri gug dbang sdud thod khrag 'khor ba stongs// dpal ldan dbyings kyi ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ sngon tshe khrag 'thung chen po'i spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa// srin po'i gzugs can gdug pa kun 'dul ba// las mgon nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// bhyoḥ nag po'i las mdzad mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso// mi bsrun gzugs 'chang dgra la dug nad 'beb// sha za khrag 'thung gtum mo rab 'bar ma// nag mo bya zhon ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ bka' nyan las byed sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// thugs dam dbang gis sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong*// drag shul stobs kyis bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod// sha za nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ mgon po'i bka' sdod 'jigs byed kun gyi gtso// stong gsum cig car myul zhing bstan pa srung*// thogs med mthu mnga' sde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad// gza' bdud rā hu la la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten las las grub pa'i dregs pa can// drag sngags dmod pa drag po'i mtshon cha yis// zhing bcu'i srog dbugs 'bral ba'i mthu bo che// las byed dregs pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhan yang nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri la sogs// 'khor tshogs sde dang dpung dang pho nyar bcas// grangs med yid bzhin 'khor lor 'char la bstod//

ces dang*/ gzhan yang rtags kyi bstod pa dang rkang brgyad ma'i bstod pa sogs spro na bstod 'bum bzhin shes par bya'o// dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i bstod pa'o// gsum pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus na mngon byung ba// che mchog he ru ka dpal sku gsum rdzogs// srid rtsa'i bdag 'dzin ru dra sde gsum 'dul// rtsal chen phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal chen mngon sprul nag po chen po'i sku /'chol ba'i khro rgyal ma ning dgra bgegs gshed// lha chen dpal 'bar chos skyong yongs kyi rje// dmag dpon chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub dkyil na// rnal 'byor dpal mgon khyod kyi cha lugs ni// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// sku gsum ldan phyir spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs// rab brjid khro gnyer gsum ldan gtum la rngam// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs drag po'i skan sgra rdeb// rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab// g.yas pa ru mtshon g.yon pa snying zhags bsnams// tsan dan beng chen rked btsugs lha dmag 'gyed// thod pa skam rlon snying phreng sbrul chun spras// dar nag ber gsol gser sked mi lpags bcings// legs ldan nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ las la chas tshe srog bdud cha lugs 'dzin// srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum brang la shar// dmag dpon bzhi 'gyed spyan bzhis lhu tshigs brgyan// stag ral gzig shubs btags nas rta nag zhon// bdud mdas dgra snying gzir 'debs gling bzhir rgyug /spyan nas khrag 'dzag me yi kha rlangs 'bar/ kha ṭwāṃ gri gug lcags par thogs nas su// snang srid pho rgyud thams cad pho nyar 'gyed// ci bcol las rnams skad cig yud la sgrub// rtag tu grogs mdzad mgon po nag po che// ma bskul bar yang brnags pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// ltag na spyan gcig ma tshogs dbang du sdud// gar bskul sa ru mi ro rags su 'tsher// zlog pas mi bzlog sngags zlog mkhan gyi gshed// gtsug lag khang srung dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod// bstan pa gnyan srung bka' yi bya ra ba// dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/

dpal ldan las kyi mgon po ni// mthing nag gri gug lcags par thogs/ kha ṭwāṃ bdud mdas dgra snying gzir// rta nag zhon nas rgyug la bstod// ma gcig lha mo dpal 'bar ma// spu gri 'phyar zhing klad khrag ldag /mi lpags gos gyon thod phreng 'phyang*// u ma de bī'i sku la bstod// hūm̐/ sku las sprul pa'i mgon po ni// nag po stag zhon mi bzad pa// tsan dan beng gsol bdud zhags 'phen// gtum po 'jigs byed khyod la bstod// ma 'gags gsung gi rol pa'i rtsal// beng chen dmar smug khros pa'i zhal// tsan dan beng dang lcags par 'dzin// bdud 'dul mthu chen khyod la bstod// thugs kyi sgyu ma chen po'i 'phrul// lha min g.yul bzlog nag po che// phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ khrag 'thung dpa' bo khyod la bstod// yon tan mgon po legs ldan che// gtum drag bzod dka'i gzi brjid can// mthing nag rin chen thod khrag 'dzin// gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod// phrin las drag shul chen po'i rtsal// trag shad bdud mgon ma rungs pa// tsan dan beng dang dgra snying 'dzin// dgra bgegs gshed ma khyod la bstod// 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti// lag na khram shing thod pa 'dzin// drel rta zhon nas stong gsum myul// nag mo stong gi gtso la bstod// he ru ka dpal spyan snga ru// dam bcas ji bzhin da lta 'dir// bstan pa srung zhing skyong mdzad pa'i// dam can kun la bstod par bgyi// dpal mgon ma ning 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod bskal me 'bar ba'i klong: rig 'dzin srog shing rnal 'byor dgra bla che: bstan pa'i bka' srung mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can: dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la bdag bstod do: srid gsum zil gnon nyams pa rtsad nas gcod: rnam bzhi'i phrin las ci bcol thogs pa med: thod phreng rtsal gyis dbang bskur dam tshig can:

sha za nag po khyod la bdag bstod do: phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: sprul pa sna tshogs stong gsum khyab par 'gyed: skye 'gro'i srog dbugs drod la dbang byed pa'i: dregs pa 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: ka dag dbyings las snying rjes khros pa'i sku/ kha dog mi bzad dus mtha'i char sprin 'dra// ga sha mgo phreng dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// nga ro'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo la bstod// ca co gdung ba'i shugs kyis bskul bsgrub tshe// cha lugs phrin las rnam bzhi'i rol gar gyis// ja ril thod pa'i gur khang bskal me'i klong*// nya rgyas ston zla'i mdzes pa ngom la bstod// ta thā ga ta'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i// tha tshig rdo rje'i dam las mi 'da' bar// da lta dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la// nam mkha' mdzod kyi dngos grub sbyin la bstod// pa sangs ltar dkar mche ba'i rno dbal gyis// pha rol sde dang bcas pa zhal stob tshe// ba lang spyod sogs gling bzhi'i dregs pa kun// ma lus zhum ste khyod skyabs gsol la bstod// tsa tur bzhin gyi sprin rum chen po las// tsha ngar rdo rje'i me char mi bzad pas// dza lang gdug pa'i dpung tshogs ma lus pa// wa skyes bzhin du 'joms par mdzad la bstod// zha rengs la sogs mi bzad cho 'phrul gyis// za ma tsam la dgra bo dpung dang bcas// 'a 'ur brlag mdzad rgyal ba'i bstan srung gtso// ya mtshan cho 'phrul cir yang ston la bstod// rwa ba gangs ris mdzes pa'i sman ljongs 'dir// la lar zhi dang la lar khro gtum gyis// sha khrag don snying dbugs la longs spyod kyang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen por gyur la bstod// ha cang gcam bu min pa'i gdung ba'i dbyangs// a la la zhes khyod la gus bstod na// ha ha'i gsung dang dgyes pa'i zhal bzang po// a ho mig gi bdud rtsir ston par mdzod//

bstan srung nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i bstod pa'o// de nas phrin las gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal ldan dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: rnam dag thugs kyi re ba yongs gang nas: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang: khams gsum 'gro kun bde skyid rab ldan zhing: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du grub par mdzod: ces phrin las bcol lo: a ti'i bstan srung drag po sde lnga yi: las byang bdud dpung kun 'joms 'di nyid ni: lo tsā bdag gis yi ger btab ste sbas: skal ldan dang 'phrad bstan srung mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ lnga pa ni/ bhyoḥ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod na// shin tu gsod pa'i smug nag khros ma ni// nam mkha'i lus can lho sprin gos su gyon// tsitta za zhing dam nyams snying khrag 'dren// zhing chung dbyug pas dgra snying tshal par 'gems// 'jigs byed chen po ral pa'i thor tshugs can// dpral na mig gcig srid gsum khungs nas 'byin// zhal na tshems gcig dgra bo'i srog gcod ma// brang na nu gcig sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong*// sha khrag longs spyod dmar gtor 'di gsol la// dam tshig dbang gis dam nyams gshed ma mdzod// ma mo srog la 'gyed phyir 'di gsol la// bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// dam tshig dus la bab bo sa ma ya// bhyoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum// sngags srung rdo rje ral gcig ma// mngon par bstod kyis dam ma 'da'// gru gsum yum gyi mkha' dbyings na// sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba ni// 'gyur med don dam thugs chud rtags// ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings pa ni/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rtags// phyag g.yas zhing chen dbyug pa ni// 'gro drug rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags// g.yon pas spyang mo khra thabs 'gyed// dgra bgegs myur du 'dren pa'i rtags// thugs las spyang mo dgu 'bum 'phro// stong khams dgra bo sgrol ba'i rtags// zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad pa ni// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'i rtags// nag mo gdug pa'i srog 'phrog ma// mngon par bstod kyis mthu ma chung*// bhyoḥ

smug nag khros ma ral gcig ma// zhing dbyug 'phyar zhing dgra snying za// 'ja' sprin gos gyon mi lpags 'phyang*// sngags srung chen mo khyod la bstod// dpal ldan bshan pa mi bsrun ma// gcer mo don snying za zhing rgyug /dgra bgegs myos byed rims nad 'beb// nam gru nag mo khyod la bstod// gtum chen gza' bdud srin po'i gzugs// mgo dgu rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags dang*// mda' gzhu 'gengs shing thog ser 'beb// sde brgyad dmag dpon khyod la bstod// sgrol ging bshan pa dmar nag ni// gri thod 'dzin zhing ral gri gdeng*// bstan dgra'i snying 'byin sbrul zhags 'phen// gnod sbyin chen po khyod la bstod// dam can skyes bu ging gi bdag /dmar nag rdo rje dgra snying 'dzin// za 'og ber gyon ra skyes zhon// mthu chen dregs pa khyod la bstod// ma thogs myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// dkar phyogs bstan pa legs skyong zhing*// nag phyogs bdud sde tshar gcod pa'i// bka' sdod pho nya kun la bstod// sngags srung ma mo 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa'o// drug pa ni/ hrī: spyan ras gzigs sprul dbang phyug lha chen po: 'jig rten mes po khams gsum kun gyi bdag: dngos grub mchog ster yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha: rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mthu chen khyod la bstod: 'od phung bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku: nyi zla'i spyan bgrad khro gnyer bzhad pa'i zhal: mche gtsigs 'dzum chags gzhan yid 'gugs pa po: gar gyi dbang phyug dpal chen bka' bzhin du: dam tshig 'khor lo'i gnas rnams skyong mdzad cing: sna tshogs dar dang ratna utpal gyis: nges par che btsan rgyal po'i rtags su brgyan: tshangs gnas ti se rgya mtsho chen po'i klong: dur khrod gnas na ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: khyod ni rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyug yin: dregs pa'i lha chen kun gyis phyag byas shing: log 'dren bgegs rnams ma lus 'dul bar mdzad:

lha yul grong khyer nags 'dabs thams cad du: lha dmag dbugs 'byin che btsan g.yul las rgyal: khams gsum kun gyi yid 'gugs lcags kyu dang: rlung gi zhags pas skye 'gro 'gugs shing 'ching: gnod sbyin gzi brjid mdangs kun rtags kyis 'phrog: u ma yum 'khyud rtag tu chags shing rol: gsang ba'i ma bzhis 'gro kun dbang du sdud: dregs pa'i lha chen kun kyang las la 'gyed: khyod ni mi bzad 'jigs byed kun gyi bdag: smon lam dbang gis rnam 'phrul cir yang ston: 'dod pa'i mchog stsol 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs: khyod la phyag 'tshal rgya chen dngos grub stsol: ces lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i bstod pa'o// bdun pa ni/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// mtshan gsol gza' mchog rā hu la// dam tshig can la bdag bstod do// rig 'dzin srog shing gter gyi bdag /gtsug lag gnyan srung mthu bo che// rnal 'byor dgra bla mthu rtsal can// dam nyams srog gcod gtso la bstod// hrīḥ khyab 'jug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin// 'jigs pa'i lus la 'bar ba'i klong*// zhal dgu phyag bzhi rngam pa ste// 'jig rten khams kyi drag rtsal can// gnam lcags thog gi bdag po ste// skyin thang ser ba 'beb pa'i gtso// sprul pa chen po rdzu 'phrul can// ri rab steng na lha yi gtso// rgya mtsho'i gting na klu yi bdag /bar snang khams su sde brgyad rje// dbu dgu srid pa gsum gyi bdag /mgo gcig lha min khros pa'i zhal// nyi ma zla ba grib mas gnon// gcig ni bzhad cing dgod pa'i zhal// dgyes pa bka' yi bya ra byed// gcig ni khros pa srin po'i gdong*// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zas su za// gcig ni rngams byed za byed gdong*// gnam lcags me yi thog chen 'beb// gcig ni 'jigs byed ma rungs pa// tsha grang 'thabs pa'i skan sgra rdeb// gcig ni 'khrug byed drag po'i zhal// g.yo 'gul chen pos ser ba 'beb// gcig ni gtum chen ye shes zhal// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med// gcig ni stobs chen rdzu 'phrul zhal// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar byed// gcig ni zhi ba lha yi zhal// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// steng gi phyogs na bya rog zhal// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par byed// glog 'dra ral gri zhags pa yis// sdang byed dgra bo'i skye rgyud gcod// chu srin zhags pa g.yugs pa yis// srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud// rwa yi mda' gzhu bsnams pa yis// dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod// spyan stong me dpung sdang mig gis// dgra dang bgegs la 'bru tshugs blta// sku smad sa la brdabs pa yis// 'jig rten g.yo 'gul ldeg par byed// zhal nas hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgrog pas// dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud// sku mdog dud ka 'jigs pa yis/

khams gsum skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// sprul pa'i gza' bdud nag po khyod// 'jig rten khams na 'gran zla med// bdud dang dregs pa bran du 'khol// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// dam can rnal 'byor skyong mdzad pa'i// mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod kyi bka' nyan gdong mo bzhi// rdzu 'phrul ri rab thal bar rlog /nad dang mtshon gyi bdag mo ste// mthu stobs can la bdag bstod do// mi bzad drag gtum rngam pa'i tshogs// gza' brgyad lha srin sde brgyad dang// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs// pho nya yang sprul tshogs la bstod// drang srong khyab 'jug 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa'o// brgyad pa ni/ bai/ sa brgyad dbang phyug sems dpa' rin chen mang*// nam mkha'i mdzod mnga' dbul ba'i gdung ba 'phrog /yid bzhin 'dod dgu'i char 'beb dpag bsam shing*// rnam mang thos sras ngal bsos po la bstod// dri med rā ga'i nying khu lan stong du// byed pos pir gyis lhun por byugs pas kyang*// mtshon min stong phrag nyi ma'i lang tsho can// gter bdag bye ba'i cod pan khyod la bstod// gangs ri'i mdzes pa 'phrog byed gdong lnga'i khrir// rab brjid gar gyis rnam rol yid bzhin gyi// rgyal mtshan sgreng zhing nor skyug ne'u le las// 'dod dgu'i char 'beb khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje'i ya lad rin chen rgyan phreng dang*// lha rdzas cod pan gyis mdzes lhab lhub g.yo// nor sbyin 'bum sde'i dbuus na lham me ba// shākya'i bstan srung gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// zag med bde ba'i dpal ster btsun mo bzhi// bka' yi blon po gter gyi bdag po brgyad// ci bgyi'i pho nya mngag gzhug sde dpung sogs// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam thos sras kyi bstod pa'o// dgu pa ni/ bhyoḥ mi 'gyur bde chen chos dbyings ngang nyid las// ma rungs 'dul phyir drag mo'i skur ston ma// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar mdzad ma mo'i gtso// rgyal ba'i bstan srung gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus mtha'i char sprin dkrigs 'dra 'jigs rungs sku

/mi bsrun bzod par dka' ba'i lang tsho can// dur khrod drag po'i rgyan phreng du mas mdzes// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ khong nas khros 'khrugs nyams brgya'i gar bsgyur ma// bstan dgra tshar gcod ma rungs don snying dang*// srid gsum mel tshe mdzad phyir me long bsnams// dur khrod ma mo'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i bka' sdod rig 'dzin pho nya mo// bstan dgra tshar gcod gsang sngags srung ma'i gtso// bka' sdod pho nya yang sprul sde dpung bcas// ma gcig lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod// zhing skyong ma mo 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa'o/ /bzhi pa rjes 'brang ni/ dam can gter srung gzhan dag gi phrin las bye brag pa rnams skabs 'dir sbyar zhing*/ de dag gi mthar gter bdag spyi'i gtor 'bul ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis gter gyi bdag po 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe padma 'byung gnas spyan snga ru// zab gter srung mar zhal bzhes dam tshig can// mthu chen gter gyi bdag po chen po rnams// rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas pa 'dir gshegs shig /ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi sogs kyis mchod pa dang sman gtor rakta rnams dbul/ zab gter srung ma'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' sdod dpa' bo che// rig 'dzin kun gyis ci bgyi'i dam tshig can// zab gter bstan pa bsrung bar dam nos pa'i// gter gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas la bstod// ces pas bstod/ gzhi bdag spyi gtor ni/

gtor ma a mṛta sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam la/ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum brjod/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra āom̐ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ā dya nutpanna twā ta āom̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ āom̐ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ zhes phyi nang gis mchod/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs gong bzhin dang*/ gzhi bdag chen po khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces 'dod pa'i phrin las gsol/ lnga pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig la sogs pa'i mthar rang rang gi srog sngags rigs kyi kha dog can gyis bskor ba/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer phog pas thugs kyi rgyud rab tu bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du sgrub par

mos la/ āom̐ badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ/ shre yāṃḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta/ he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces he ru ka'i yig brgya dang*/ gong gnon gyi bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas bzla bya'i sngags ni/ āom̐ bhu ru ku ru i tsi ki byi u tsuṣma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces legs ldan tshogs bdag go / āom̐ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa: ces phyag bzhi pa/ āom̐ ma hā kā la e ka dzā ṭi gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa: phyag bzhi pa yab yum sbrel ma/ āom̐ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu hya raṃ siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ning ngo*// āom̐ ma hā kā la bi kā la tri yaṃ dza: zhal bzhi pa'o// trag raksha kha munt+ra mu ru mu ru hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ rakmo te keṃ tsa tsha kha la bhyo ru lu ru lu ma ti bhyo/ sngags srung ngo*// āom̐ ma hā de ba sa ma ya hrīṃ dza: zhes lha chen bsnyen sngags dang*/ āom̐ ma hā de wa dzaḥ.u ma de wī hrīṃ ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes sgrub sngags thun mong ba'o// hri shag ru rag raṃ nā ge tsitta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha ha ga sha la dzaḥdzaḥ gza' bdud do// āom̐ ma hā rā dza sa ma ya bai shra ma ṇa ye sarba tsitta ratna hrīṃ dzaḥ rnam sras so// āom̐ ma ma ra li pra ma ya kā li ye dzaḥdzaḥ dur khrod ma mo dang*/ āom̐ ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ ya di pra tī dzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/

zhes gtso 'khor thun mong ste/ 'di rnams ji tsam nus pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ āom̐ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ zhes mchod cing*/ hūm̐/ drag po sku lnga rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mchog /ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'khor// phrin las bdud 'dul dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsan cing dgongs su gsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas dgyes par mdzod// dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyams chag mthol zhing bshags// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /drug pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa/ mchod bshags bsgral stob rnams bdag bskyed kyi cho ga gang la brten pa'i skabs dang mthun par 'dir sbyar ro/ /bdun pa thugs dam skong ba'i rim pa la/ dam can so so'i skong ba/ bshags pa/ phrin bcol dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ skong rdzas rnams a mṛta sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las gnas khang dur khrod drag po'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab par/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa spyan gzigs mthun rdzas rten rdzas skong rdzas la sogs pa thams cad srid zhi'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa mkho dgu tshang ba/ bzang dgus 'byor pa/ mdzes dgus brgyan pa/ ngo bo ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin bde ba'i rnam pa thams cad par 'char bas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlab cing zad mi shes par spel la/ dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// dam la gnas shing lha la 'phreng*/

khyod ni srung ma mthu rtsal can// sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ khyod kyi dam bca' gnyan po de// da lta rnal 'byor bdag bskul na// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// ma hā kā la gnas 'dir byon// legs ldan nag po gnas 'dir byon// dur khrod sgrol ging gnas 'dir byon// rdo rje sgrol byed gnas 'dir byon// sa bcu'i dbang phyug gnas 'dir byon// rig 'dzin srung ma gnas 'dir byon// rnal 'byor dgra bla gnas 'dir byon// tshogs bdag chen po gnas 'dir byon// bos so chos skyong snyan ma sra// g.yab bo legs ldan spyan ma brtul// sgrub bo tshogs bdag gong ma g.yel// bskul lo bdud rgyal mthu ma chung*// do nub khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag dang*// 'phan gdugs lhab lhub sna tshogs kyis// legs ldan 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// sha chen lnga ni ri ltar spungs// bdud rtsi lnga ni mtsho ltar bskyil// ye shes lnga ldan dam rdzas 'dis// dpal mgon 'khor bcas thugs= sha chen khrag dang dbang po lnga// tshil chen zhun mar mkhris pa dang*// g.yang gzhi lhab lhub rkang gling sgras// dpal mgon 'khor bcas thugs= dmar chen bza' bca'i gtor ma dang*// 'bru bcud bdud rtsi btung ba'i rgyun/ khyad par dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis// dpal mgon 'khor bcas thugs= gling bzhi gling phran ri rab dang*// rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa yis// dpal mgon 'khor bcas thugs= g.yag nag rta nag khyi nag dang*// lug nag bya nag la sogs pa// rten pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis// dpal mgon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// zhes pa tsam gyi mthar/ bskang ngo bshags so thugs dam can// dam can thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// bdag gi nyams chag byang bar mdzod// dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam pa thams cad sgrubs// rtag tu thugs dam ma g.yel bar// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod//

ces bskang bar bya'o// ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi// rnam mang rol pa las byung mchod pa'i sprin/ khrag chen rgya mtsho zhag gi lbu phreng can// gnag pa'i chu skyes lang tsho mi sdug 'jigs// gsur chen dud pa'i sprin phung lang long g.yo// zhun chen sgron me'i 'od kyis stong gsum 'geng*/ khrag zhag byug pa ga pur dri ngad ldang*// sha rus bza' ba'i tshogs rnams ro brgyar ldan// yan lag 'bum ldan dbyangs kyi nga ro sogs// zag med mchog gi 'dod yon longs spyod kyis// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs 'dod yon gtor chen ri ltar spungs/ khrag zhag bdud rtsi'i btung ba rgya mtshor bskyil// māṃ sa don snying nang rol rdza ltar lhags// bda' zhing bsung ba'i kha zas g.yos su sbyar// sman spos rtsi bcud nor dbyig ji snyed dang*// yid 'phrog phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i dam tshig sogs// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis dpag yas mkha' bkang nas// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= sna tshogs rgyan spras rta nag rlung ltar 'phyo// g.yag rog zhol chen sprin rum ltar 'gying zhing*// bdud lug spyi dkar lcags rwa 'khyil ba can/ khyi nag dom bu 'dur zhing khrag rjes gcod// gnam lcags mchu ldan bya nag 'phur zhing lding*// dgra bgegs srog la 'jab pa'i bya gcan sogs// zhing kun dog por byed pa'i rten rnams kyis// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal med rngams shing brjid// 'bod pa'i g.yab dar sna tshogs lhab lhub g.yo// dur khrod drag po'i rgyan phreng tshar du dngar// sna tshogs dar snas dpyangs pa'i bya rgod mda'// gri gug ral gri beng sogs phyag mtshan dang*// gnag pa'i zhwa gos gzugs rten gtor ma sogs// bzhed dgu tshang ba'i 'byor pa ji snyed kyis// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs=

dpa' bo g.yul du mtshon gyis bsad pa'i snying*// 'khrul med srog gi 'khor los bkang ba dang*// rang byung rten rdo gru gsum nal bu'i snying*// bzang po'i sman dang rin chen 'bru sna lnga// gri lcags thog mde'u zangs khab srog snying bcas// stag gzig ras ma le brgan dar tshon sogs// spyi dang khyad par gsang ba'i rten rnams kyis// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs rgya mtshos gang ba yi// gling bzhi ri rab rol mtshor bcas pa dang*// bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma rmos lo thog bsam 'phel rin chen gter// sna tshogs nor dbyig go mtshon dpa' bo'i chas// shis pa'i rtags rdzas rin chen bdun la sogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khyon gang bas// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= chos kyi dbyings las khrag 'thung dpa' bo'i skur// bstan kyang gdod nas dag pa'i rang sems dang*// dbyer med rang ngo shes pa'i rnal 'byor sogs// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pas thugs dam bskang*// gnyis med bde ba chen por dgyes gyur te// 'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang*// thub pa'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du// rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs rgyas par mdzod// ces bskang ngo*// dpal mgon ma ning gi skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes khro bo'i skur ston cing*// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad he ru ka /mthu chen dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*// mig sman mdangs can rta mchog sogs// phyi yi rten gyis thugs dam bskang*// 'dod yon bya rog rgyal mtshan bcas// nang gi rten gyis thugs= gri snying srog gi 'khor lo sogs// gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs= 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// g.yab dar nag pos thugs= gshegs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dbyangs rnga rol mos thugs= gnas kyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// thod mkhar 'bar bas thugs=

bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// pad nyi ro yis thugs= rgyan gyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dur khrod chas kyis thugs= dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs= ngom pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dmar chen raktas thugs= tshim pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// dpal gyi gtor mas thugs= mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sna tshogs nor gyis thugs= rten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// gzugs rten bla rdos thugs= bza' ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// sha chen sna lngas thugs= btung ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// bdud rtsi sna lngas thugs= mchod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir// srid zhi'i 'byor pas thugs= sku yi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// phyag rgya gsal rdzogs thugs= gsung gi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// rlung sngags bzlas pas thugs= thugs kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// ting 'dzin brtan pas thugs= yon tan thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// 'dod yon mkho dgus thugs= phrin las thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir// las sbyor 'bad pas thugs= bskang ngo gsol lo thugs dam bskang*// dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang*// sprul pa rnam lnga mthu chen brgyad// 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyan skong dngos grub stsol// zhes bskang ngo*// bka' srung drag po sde lnga'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal thugs rjes khros pa'i gar// mi bzad bdud kyi stobs 'phrog nag po che// 'jigs rung srin po'i gzugs can gdong bzhi pa// bka' sdod pho nyar bcas pa da tshur byon// pha mtha' brdal ba'i 'jig rten khyon gang ba'i// dngos bshams yid sprul 'dod yon 'byor pa'i tshogs// ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bur// 'bul lo brtse bas dgongs te bzhes su gsol// gdug can dgra dang bgegs rnams bsgral pa yi// gzugs phung las grub dmar gyi arghaṃ dang*// drag po'i nyer spyod snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra

/sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lngas thugs dam bskang*// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro bda' dang*// reg bde rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis pa'i// rtags rdzas lha mi'i 'dod yon 'byor pa'i tshogs// mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyis thugs dam bskang*// 'chi med bdud rtsi dza gad ma da na// dgra bgegs snying khrag lbu phreng 'khrug pa'i mtsho// lhun po ltar brjid 'dod dgu'i ba liṃ ta// mnyam sbyor dga' bzhi'i rol pas thugs= myur 'gro'i cang shes brjid ldan g.yag rgod dang*// mdzes pa'i lug nag bya rog 'phur lding g.yo// dpa' gtum khyi sogs kun kyang mun pa'i mdog /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pas thugs= dar nag g.yab dar 'dod yon dur khrod chas// nag po'i zhwa gos gri gug ral gri dang*// mdung thung bhañdza bya rog rgyal mtshan sogs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs kyis thugs= sku gzugs sngags byang gri rgod snying nang du// srog 'khor bla rdo'i chas bcug smyug rgod mda'// stag gzig ras ma dar snas dpyangs pa sogs// mi 'bral gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs= rnam bkra'i spyan gzigs khor yug kun tu bres// gar 'cham phyag rgya'i rol gar brjid bag g.yo// yas stags mdos kyis snang srid ma 'dres 'char// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun tshogs pas thugs= phung khams sbyang gzhi bskyed rdzogs lam gyis sbyong// bsnyen sgrub las kyi sbyor ba rtse mor son// chos kun ka nas dag pa'i bde chen gdangs// sgyu ma'i rol par shar bas thugs dam bskang*// zhes bskang ngo*// ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i skong ba ni/ bhyoḥ ye shes ma mo khrag 'thung yum// sngags srung rdo rje ral gcig ma// 'khor bcas mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyis// thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag bshags/ khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i arghaṃ dang*// dbang po lnga yi me tog dang// gsur chen spos kyi dud sprin dang*// zhun chen sgron mes thugs dam bskang*// mkhris chen bdud rtsi'i dri chab dang*// sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas dang*// rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo sogs// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// sna tshogs snying dang khrag sna 'bum// btsos dang rjen sha dkar mngar bcud// myos byed dza gad 'bru sman dbyig

/'dod yon mchod pas thugs= bya nag khyi dang za le 'bri// tsa ra lug dang dre 'u rnams// mdzes sdug rnam bkra'i rgyan cha can// 'bum phrag mang pos thugs= sku gzugs sngags byang rtse gsum mdung*// sba lcag tshigs gsum rang byung mtshal// byang sems nal bu'i rgyal mtshan snying*// sha khrag snying snas thugs= gtor chen sman phud spyi blugs zhwa// rma bya'i rgyal mtshan le brgan gur// bam chen snel mo'i mgo lpags sogs// srog 'khor bla rdos thugs= rngam brjid thod mkhar dur khrod gnas// dpal gyi chas gos rgyan phreng dang*// sna tshogs dkor nor spyan gzigs sogs// 'dod yon mkho dgus thugs= gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam tshig rdzas// lha mi'i 'byor tshogs mchod pa'i sprin// dngos bshams yid kyi rnam rol las// gang bzhed de der 'char bas bskang*/ khyad par khyod sku snang stong sku /gsal brtan grags stong sngags su sbyar// bde stong thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// rang rig 'du 'bral med par bskang*// ngo bo dus gsum rgyal kun yum// rnam pa sngags srung khrag 'thung tshul// gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal can// smug nag khros ma'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes ma mo'i thugs= khrag 'thung yum gcig thugs= sngags srung khros ma'i thugs= e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs= sprul pa rnam gsum ging chen gsum// pho nya ye shes 'jig rten dang*// dam tshig sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'bum phrag 'khor bcas thugs= bshan pa srog sgrub gza' bdud dang*// sgrol ging rdo rje legs pa rnams// lcam dral bka' sdod pho nyar bcas// 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// dam can thugs dam dgyes bskang zhing*// bdag cag nyams chag byang ba dang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi'i// dngos grub chen po grub par mdzod// ces bskang ngo*// lha chen gyi skong ba ni/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin// padma gar dbang thugs rje'i rnam rol las// gdul dka' 'dul phyir 'jig rten mgon po'i skur// yongs bzhengs lha chen lcam dral 'dir gshegs shig

/chos nyid 'gyur med dbyings las bde chen gyi// rnam rol ma 'gags 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin// dpag yas nam mkha'i khams kun yongs gang bas// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang// le brgan dar gyi lhab lhub g.yab mo dang*// dam rdzas sbyar ba'i spos kyi dud sprin gtibs// ting 'dzin sngags rgya gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgras// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= padma rā ga'i khang bzang zla gam dbyibs// ngo mtshar rgyan gyi khyad par du ma yis// rab mdzes pho brang gnas kyi rten mchog 'dis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= mngar gsum sbyar ba'i skyems dang me tog spos// mar me dri mchog zhal zas snyan brjid kyi// rol mor bcas pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= mdzes pa'i gzugs dang dbyangs snyan bzang po'i dri// ro brgya'i bza' btung reg bya'i khyad par sogs// dbang po'i spyod yul 'dod yon rnam pa lngas// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= mnga' che'i 'byor pa rin chen sna bdun dang*// bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad dang 'jo sgeg gi /rnam 'gyur mtha' yas lha mo'i rol rtsed kyis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= 'bru bzang sman spod sna tshogs mngar gsum gyis// sbrus pa'i bshos bu sha chen khur ba dang*// la du myos byed zho mar gyis bran pas// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= mngar gsum myos byed sbyar ba'i btung ba dang*// rang byung me tog til gyi sgron me sbar// tsandan chab sogs khyad par dam rdzas kyis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*// dmar chen rakta rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus// 'dod dgu'i rten gtor lhun po ltar spungs pas// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= seng ge stag gzig dom dang mkha' lding tshogs// rta mchog glang chen ma he ba lang khyung*// mdzes brjid mkho dgu'i srog chags sna tshogs kyis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs=

khyad par rgyu las bzo bos cho ga bzhin// bsgrubs pa'i dam tshig mchog gi bris sku dang*// glegs bam bgrang phreng sngags kyi phyag rgya yis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= gzugs 'tshong las byung lcags las byas pa yis// lcags kyu le brgan dar gyis brgyan pa dang*// dbang sdud 'ching byed nyi zla'i zer can gyis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= yab yum srog 'khor bla rten phur bu dang*// lha 'dre mi'i srog dam rdzas dkor char bcas// srid mes snod du gtams pa'i gsang rten gyis// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= snang stong sku yi phyag rgya gsal zhing brtan// bzlas brjod sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul// rig stong spros bral ka dag gzhir rdzogs pas// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= sems nyid gdod nas dag pa rig pa'i gshis// rtsal snang 'gag med 'char ba sgyu ma'i 'phrul// rang shar rang grol gnas lugs ji bzhin dbyings// lha chen lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs= stong nyid dbyings dang bde chen ye shes rtsal// gnyis med dbyings su thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// mngon par 'dod pa'i phrin las ma lus pa// thogs pa med pa myur du 'grub par mdzod//

ces bskang zhing*/ gza' bdud kyi skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// dmar chen rgyan gyi gtor ma dang*// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*// sha sna snying sna'i mchod pa yis// gza' mchog chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// bskangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'bru bzang lha bshos sha chen spos// tshil chen snang gsal rol mo'i tshogs// sku glud spyan gzigs mang po dang*// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma yis// gza' bdud yab yum thugs dam bskang*// rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ gyis// ljang sngon drag po'i thugs= sha chen ri rab brtsegs pa yis// bdud po rog ti'i thugs= bsad khrag rba klong 'khrug pa yis/ khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs= spos dang snang gsal rol mo yis// drang srong dkar ser thugs= bam chen bcad 'phror ldan pa yis// biṣṭi pa tra'i thugs= ti ra zhing chen spungs pa yis// ha li ka li'i thugs= dmar dang gsur chen dud pa yis// du ba mjug ring thugs= spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lo yis// sgra gcan 'dzin gyi thugs= sha khrag dmar chen gtor ma yis// sring mo bzhi yi thugs= gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo yis// gza' chen brgyad kyi thugs= g.yos dang kha zas sna tshogs kyis// rgyu skar nyer brgyad thugs= sha sna snying sna 'bum phrag gis// lha srin sde brgyad thugs= bskang ngo bskang ngo gza' chen rnams// thugs dam gnyan po skong bar mdzod// chos skyong gza' bdud 'khor bcas la// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// dga' dang gus pas phyag btsal nas// mos shing dad pas mchod pa 'bul// rnal 'byor nyams chag skong bar mdzod// ces bskang ngo*// rgyal chen rnam sras kyi skong ba ni/ bai/ khor yug bcas pa'i 'jig rten khyon gang ba'i// mtho ris 'byor pa 'dod dgur 'jo ba'i dpyid// sman spos rtsi bcud shing thog sna tshogs dang*// ngo mtshar mchod sprin rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*// rin chen khang bzang gter dang nor bus spras// phun tshogs 'dod pa'i longs spyod sprin phung gtibs// gos sngon stod g.yogs lung thang phreng ba sogs// gsang chen dam tshig gnyan pos thugs=

cang shes rta mchog gnyis 'thung 'dod 'jo'i ba// mdzes sdug rgyan gyis spras pa ji snyed dang*// yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i gter gyi sgrom bu sogs// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyis thugs= bdud las rnam rgyal mdung dmar rgyal mtshan sgreng*// sku gzugs rten gtor srog 'khor bla rdo dang*// rin chen ya lad spyan gzigs dkor cha sogs// dpag yas nam mkha' gang bas thugs= gzhan yang srid zhi'i 'dod yon ci mchis pa/ khyod kyi bzhed pa gang yin de dag kun// 'bul gyis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// bsam pa'i re ba gang ba'i mchog stsol cig / ces bskang ngo// zhing skyong dur khrod ma mo'i skong ba ni/ bhyoḥ sgyu 'phrul klong las shar ba'i mchod sprin ni// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang ba'i ngo mtshar phul// so so'i thugs la dgyes dgu'i char 'beb pas// zhing skyong dur khrod ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*// dgra bgegs srog rtsa'i khrag dang dbang po lnga// tshil gsur zhun chen mar nag sgron me sbar/ khrag zhag dri chab sha rus don snying lnga// rkang gling rol mor bcas pas thugs= gnag pa'i spu sdug brjid pa'i zhol mo dang*// dre'u nag bong bu sprin gyi shugs ldan rta// 'phar spyang dred sogs dbang po kun tshang ba// yid 'phrog rgyan gyis mdzes pas thugs= rlung ras dpyangs pa'i nal bu'i rgyal mtshan dang*// rnam bkra'i dar tshon me long bya rgod mda'// bzhed dgu'i rten gtor tshogs dang nal bu'i snying*// srog gi 'khor los bkang bas thugs= sra ba'i go cha rno ba'i mtshon cha dang// mdzes pa'i rgyan cha brjid pa'i dkor cha'i tshogs// blta bas ngoms pa med pa'i spyan gzigs sogs// mtho ris 'byor pa rgya mtshos thugs= gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub las kyi sbyor ba dang*// mthun zhing brten pa'i dam tshig rdzas kyi tshogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams gang bas// ma gcig lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// zhing skyong ma mo khyod mchod bsnyen pa yis// sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob la// 'brum pa la sogs 'go ba'i nad rims dang*// mi mthun 'gal rkyen gnod pa'i phyogs rnams las// skyob pa'i phrin las g.yel ba med pa dang*// mthun rkyen rnam dag bsam don myur 'grub mdzod//

ces skong ba'i phrin las rnams dbyangs kyi 'gyur ba rol mo'i sbyor ba dang lhan cig pas gyer zhing sbyar ba'i spos kyi rgyun btul ba sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa legs ldan gyi bshags pa ni/ hoḥ yon tan lhun rdzogs dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// dpal chen rdo rje srin po khro bo'i rgyal// legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// theg chen gsang sngags bla med sgor zhugs nas// spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams// rtag tu bsrung zhing sdom par khas blangs nas// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul nongs pa mthol lo bshags// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor bsgom par khas blangs nas// tha mal las la yengs pa mthol lo bshags// bde gshegs thugs rgyud bskul bar khas blangs nas// tha mal long gtam smras pa mthol lo bshags// dmigs med ye shes bsgom par khas blangs nas// dug gsum rtog pa'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags// phyi nang gsang rten 'dzugs par khas blangs nas// dgos pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang mthol lo bshags// rtag tu mchod bstod bsnyen par khas blangs nas// snyom las le los yengs pa mthol lo bshags// man ngag sbas nas bsgrub par khas blangs nas// gsang ba'i gnyer kha 'chol ba mthol lo bshags// dam rdzas phud kyis mchod par khas blangs nas// 'bag btsog nyams par gyur pa mthol lo bshags// rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs nas// gzu lum ras chod bgyis pa mthol lo bshags// zol med dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs nas// nyams grib skyon gyis phog pa mthol lo bshags// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig 'gal pa ma lus so sor bshags// mthol bshags 'bul lo tshangs par mdzad nas kyang*// dngos grub mchog gis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod// ces dang yig brgya mang du bzla'o// lha chen gyi bshags pa ni/ hrīḥ gar gyi dbang phyug thugs rje'i rnam rol las// 'jig rten skyong ba yongs kyi rje bo'i skur// rab bzhengs lha chen lcam dral 'khor dang bcas// thugs rjes bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// bdag cag mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pas// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis bcas pa dang*// rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i nongs pa kun// gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing bshags par bgyi// snang srid rnam dag lha skur rdzogs pa la// ma dag tha mal snang zhen bden 'dzin gyis// sgom sgrub g.yel zhing mi dge'i g.yeng bas gol// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// gzhom med rlung sngags nā da'i rang bzhin la// tha snyad yi ge'i brda dang mtshan mas bcings// bzlas brjod ma dag long gtam 'khrul pas bslad// gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// chos kun ye nas spros dang bral ba la// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog mtshan mas ris su bcad// gnas lugs ma rtogs 'khrul snang mun par 'thoms// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// skyon dag yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs shing*// sras bcas rgyal ba'i ye shes rnam rol la// tshur mthong phyogs re'i bsam pas gzhal ba sogs// yon tan dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// phrin las rnam bzhis 'dod don ma lus pa// yid bzhin nor ltar thogs med re skong la// byis blos nyi tshe'i las la bkol pa sogs// phrin las dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags// rdo rje'i yal gam chen po gnyer blangs kyang*// spyi dang khyad par gyur pa'i dam tshig las// nongs shing nyams par gyur pa gang bgyis pa// mthol zhing bshags so tshangs shing dag par mdzod//

ces dang yi ge brgya pa bzla/ de nas gzhung gi bshags pa dngos ni/ hoḥ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs pa// rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// 'khor bcas bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// bdag cag blun rmongs ma rig 'khrul pa'i yid// las dang nyon mongs bag chags kyis dkrugs pas// lha khyod bsnyen cing bsgrub par dam bcas kyang*// sku yi phyag rgya ma gsal don ma rtogs// sngags kyi bzlas brjod ma dag lhag chad 'khrug /yid kyi ting 'dzin bying rgod rtog pas bslad// dam rdzas ma tshang rten rdzas ma tshogs dang*// rgyu chung phud nyams 'bag btsog dri mas gos// dus kyi mchod gtor 'gyangs shing chag pa dang*// bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing las sbyor log pa sogs// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun// rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du bzhes nas kyang*// nyams chag sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams kun byang ste// 'gyur med tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzhi gsum sogs kyis thugs dam ma bskang ba rnams bshags par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'dod pa'i don la phrin las gsol ba la/ lha chen dbang phyug chen por phrin las bye brag tu gsol bar spro na/ gtor ma gsar du bshams pa'am kha gsos pa āom̐ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas sngags mchod sngon du 'gro bas/ hrī: bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: dpal ldan khrag 'thung rta mchog dpal: thugs rje chen po'i rol pa las: gu lang chen po lha yi lha: dbang phyug shrī ral pa can: dregs pa'i sde dpon mthu chen khyod: tshangs pa'i gnas dang rgya mtsho'i gling: gangs dkar rtse dang tsandan nags: grub pa'i gnas nas sku bzhengs shig: sku mdog dmar po bskal pa yi: me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud:

phyag mtshan lcags kyu zhags pa yis: 'gro ba'i yid 'gugs 'ching bar mdzad: zur phud zla ba tshes pas brgyan: gsang ba'i rtags kyis snod bcud kyi: gzi mdangs yon tan ma lus sdud: yum chen lha mo dka' zlog ma: rtag tu chags shing bde la rol: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: gsang ba'i ma bzhi las la 'gyed: khams gsum kun gyi yid 'gugs shing: myos dang rmongs dang 'ching bar mdzad: dus la bab bo phrin las mdzod: tshangs dang 'dod lha dbang po sogs: dregs pa'i lha chen thams cad kyang: khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags te: 'jig rten gsum na dgra las rgyal: dka' thub grub pa khyod kyi mthus: zil gyis mi non gang yang med: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i: thugs dam da lta bskul lags so: dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas rnams kyis: khams gsum srid pa thams cad la: 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyus thobs: rlung gi zhags pas yid chings la: rang dbang gtan pa dang phral nas: bdag gi dbang du 'dus par mdzod: gdug can dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: thams cad drag po'i dmod pas gzir: rig sngags sbyor bas byad du chug: lus ngag rdul bzhin brlags nas kyang: lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod: sha khrag zan chan khur ba dang: spos dang me tog la sogs pa: mthun pa'i dam rdzas kun bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: bar chad sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs: bcol pa'i las rnams ma lus pa: skad cig tsam la grub par mdzod: dus la bab bo dbang phyug che: pho nya bran dang mngags par bcas: phrin las ma g.yel sa ma ya: zhes 'dod pa'i don la yid rtse gcig pas bskul zhing las kyi gnyer gtad par bya'o// gang ltar phrin las gsol ba dngos ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung rdo rje nag po che// lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas rnams la// phrin las rab 'byams gsol dang bskul ba'i phyir// mchod sprin rgya mtsho bstabs pas dgyes gyur te// kun bzang he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag padma 'byung*// mchog gi sa brnyes rdo rje'i rig 'dzin tshogs// rim par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma yis// rgyud gsum dam can dregs pa'i dpung tshogs rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod// bsten cing bsgrubs nas dbang bskur dam bzhag pa'i// zhal bzhes thugs dam g.yel bar ma mdzad par// srid zhi'i phun sum tshogs kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang// de tshul lung rtogs bshad sgrub kyis 'tsho ba'i// bstan 'dzin yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// dge bcu'i 'byor pa rgya mtshos 'tsho ba dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi snod bcud legs tshogs kun// rab 'phel rdzogs ldan dpal gyis mtho bar mdzod/

khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs// phyi nang mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing*// bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod stobs// thos bsam sgom pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// sa gsum 'gro ba rnams dang de dag gi /phun tshogs dpal kun dbang du bsdu bar mdzod// mi bsrun log par sems pa'i dgra dang bgegs// nag phyogs bdud sde'i dpung dang bcas pa rnams// phrin las drag po shin tu mi bzad pas// ye shes dbyings su sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// sems nyid gdod ma'i bstan srung re dogs dris// bslad min mtha' bral bde chen mngon gyur nas// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i re skong ba'i// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams// mthun pa'i rdzas 'dir rten bcas dgyes bzhugs nas// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen bsam don sgrubs// chos 'khor 'di yi bstan pa sde dang bcas/ khyod la gtad do rtag tu g.yel med skyongs// mthu rtsal nus skyed 'gal byed chom la phob// 'dod don bcol ba'i las kun bsgrub par mdzod// ces las kyi gnyer gtad cing mngon par 'dod pa'i phrin las la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma gtang*/ brgyad pa khyad par mngon spyod kyi yul la rbad cing bskul ba ni man ngag gi yi ge gud du bkod pa las shes par bya'o/ /dgu pa gtor ma stob pa ni/ 'bul gtor rnams la dpal 'bar btsugs/ spos dang rol mo gser skyems kyis mtshon par sgrub khang gi yang thog sogs gang du gtong ba'i sar khyer la dmigs bya dgug pa ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang*/ skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig /

rtsa sngags shā sa na 'i mthar nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bstim/ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ āom̐ ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇa ya di pra tī dzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭān kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛhna gṛhna/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ sa pa ri wā ra sogs gsum gyis phul la/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs pa// mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rje nag po che// lcam dral bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// 'khor bcas thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig /phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka ba liṃ ta// dgra bgegs sha khrag la sogs mkho dgu'i rdzas// so so'i thugs la ci bzhed der 'char ba'i// rmad byung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin chen po 'di// sngar mdzad legs pa'i las kyi gtang rag dang*// slad nas g.yel ba med pa'i phrin las bzhi'i// 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol slad 'bul lags na// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes shing rol nas kyang*// bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde kun spel zhing*/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams// nad med pa dang mi 'gyur tshe srog dpal// grags dang 'byor pa rgya mtshos mtho ba dang*// ma rung bdud dgra'i rgol ba kun zhi zhing*// rnam mang phrin las rgya mtsho yid bzhin sgrubs// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon phyor// byang chub bar du bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzod// ces gtor ma stob cing 'dod don gsol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la drug las/ dang po gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ āom̐ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda 'i bar dang*/ bstod pa ni/ he ru ka dpal spyan snga ru// dam bcas ji bzhin da lta 'dir// bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong mdzad pa'i// dam can kun la bstod par bgyi//

zhes dang*/ gnyis pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pas ting nge 'dzin ma gsal pa dang*/ tshogs ma dag pa dang dzap bzlas nyung zhing cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa/ mchod pa'i yo byad dman pa la sogs pa srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal ba'i rkyen du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de/ chos dbyings ka dag chen po'i klong du lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa 'chags/ gsum pa brtan bzhugs ni/ rten yod pa rnams la phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ āom̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ bzhi pa gshegs gsol ni/ āom̐/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥ se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas/ ye shes pa rnams chos dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid dang gnyis su med par gyur/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor rnams gatstsha gatstsha swā bhā wā nāṃ

gyis rang gnas su btang*/ lnga pa smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngo/ drug pa shis brjod ni/ rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo'i mgon// gsang gsum 'gyur med bde chen rdo rje'i sems// 'gro la phan bde'i mchog stsol dpag bsam shing*// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos sku'i mkha' la grangs med gzugs sku'i sprin// zhi khro nyams brgya'i rol par 'char ba las// dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char du snyil mdzad pa'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /he ru ka dpal snying rje'i rol gar ni// gtum chen bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid kyis// nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas mthar mdzad pa'i// dpal 'bar ma hā kā la'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mi bzad drag shul can// bdud dpung tshar gcod sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong*// phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog / ces sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa du mas phyogs kun tu bde legs kyi snang ba chen pos yongs su khyab par bya'o// dpa' bo gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i bsam pa kun 'grub cing*// ma rungs bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i// dam tshig can gyi bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// phul byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// zag med bde stong rol pa'i dga' ston gyis// mchod las dngos grub rnam pa thams cad pa// dka' ba med par thob la mi rtsol su// de phyir so so'i rgyud gzhung nges pa dang*// grub pa mchog gi zhal lung la brten nas// legs par bsdebs 'dis gnas skabs mthar thug gi /don gnyis 'dod dgur 'jo ba'i dpag bsam shing*// de phyir dam tshig can gyi sngags 'chang gis// tshul bzhin bsnyen cing phrin las bskul ba sogs// nan tan lhur byed de la mchog thun gyi// dngos grub rgya mtshor chu bran ji bzhin 'du// de phyir dam pa'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rnam dpyod yol gor bskyil pas 'dod dgu'i dpal// thogs pa med par 'jo 'di sngon med kyi// legs bshad dngo~Xs gruba~X rola~X pa'i mtsho~X chen yin// 'dir 'bad dge tshogs nyin byed ltar 'bar bas// ma lus bdud sde'i mun pa kun bcil bas// thub bstan phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad byed pa'i// dge legs srid zhi'i rtse mor 'bar gyur cig

/de ltar bstan pa skyong ba'i dam can chen po rnams kyi phrin las dngos grub kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni rig pa 'dzin pa 'gyur med rdo rjes so so'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung rnams las ngag 'don snying por dril nas dkyus gcig tu bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni lo tsā ba ngag dbang chos dpal lo// sarba dā maṅgalaṃ/// /
